companies.coverage_notes: Coverage is good for every quarterly report 2022-2026 (production, sales, realised price, unit cost), every half/full-year result, guidance changes, P680/P1000/P2000, the Ngungaju curtailment (Oct-2024, effective 1 Dec 2024) and restart (approved Feb-2026, restarted 1 Jul 2026), the offtakes (Ganfeng, Chengxin, Canmax), the financings (EFA/NAIF, RCF, 2031 notes) and the Latin Resources/Colina deal. Thin spots: (1) 2022 H1 capital events. The P680 FID (June 2022), the POSCO JV completion (13 Apr 2022), the Calix JV terms and Dale Henderson's CEO appointment (Jul 2022) come only from later documents, so the P680 FID is dated 2022-07-11 (first retrieved doc) and the others are folded into later events or left out. (2) The Feb-2023 tolled-hydroxide spot sale, the CATL sell-down of its 4.9% stake (Mar 2023) and the resource upgrade reported in the Jun-2025 quarter only appear in later articles. The resource upgrade is dated to the first retrieved article (2025-07-20). (3) Some Dec-2021, Mar-2022 and Mar-2024 A$ unit costs appear only in garbled transcripts or in conflicting currencies, so they were left out of metrics. For Sep-2022 and Mar-2024 the US$ unit costs reported by Motley Fool are used instead. (4) The Dec-2025 quarter realised price in US$ was not in the retrieved text (only '+50% q/q'). (5) Realised price basis changes over time: SC6 CIF in 2022, ~SC5.3-5.4 with an SC6-equivalent from late 2022, and SC5.2 in 2026. Several Motley Fool figures give no grade and are labelled 'as reported'. Metadata caveats: 'Model ML - Regulatory Filings' interim/annual reports are sometimes timestamped at the period end (e.g. 2022-12-31 or 2023-12-31) rather than the release date. Those were used only as supporting sources, never as first_seen. A few Quartr 'PLS Group Limited' report duplicates for 2023 and 2025 carry timestamps a day before the actual release, so they were excluded. Midnight (00:00:00Z) timestamps on Model ML filings are date-only. Two conflicting figures were left out: the FY26 P2000 pre-FID amount (A$135M vs A$165M vs A$175M across sources) and one wire's FY27 production range of 1.0-1.3Mt, so the 1.03-1.10Mt range from the transcript/wires was used. companies.coverage_notes: SPEC/BASIS for SC6 comparison: Sigma's product is nominally 5.5% Li2O spodumene concentrate (Q3-23 produced 5.7%; sold 5.5% Q2-24, 5.2% Q3-24, 5.0% Q1-25, 5.2% Q2-25; ~5% average by 2026). Price basis shifted over time: 2023-early 2024 = 9% of LME/Asian lithium hydroxide price, FOB Vitoria, provisional with ~1-2 month quotational period (big later provisional adjustments); from Q2-24 reported CIF China; from 2025 quoted as SC6 CIF China then netted down for grade; Q1-26 realised stated on an SC5 basis. Unit costs are reported at plant gate, FOB Vitoria and CIF China (CIF incl. royalties until 2025; 2026 CIF figure excludes royalties). 'Lithium fines' (~1% Li2O reprocessed tailings, 2025-26) and ~1.3% Li2O by-products (2023) are separate low-grade products. 2022: pre-production year (construction of the Greentech plant); no production, shipments or realised prices exist. Events are study/construction/financing milestones; unit costs in 2022 are study estimates, not actuals. 2023: first production Apr-2023, first shipment Jul-2023, first revenue quarter Q3-2023 (only Q3 has full KPI table retrieved; Q1/Q2 2023 were pre-revenue). Pricing basis early on was 9% of the lithium hydroxide price (avg China/Japan/Korea, LME), FOB Vitoria, 5.5% Li2O concentrate; Q3-2023 grade produced 5.7%. Q4-2023 KPIs appear in the 2024 section (reported Mar-2024). 2024: full KPI tables retrieved for Q4-23 (partial), Q1, Q2, Q3; Q4-2024 financials appear in 2025. Pricing moved from FOB to CIF reporting in Q2-2024 (CIF China equivalent). Grade sold 5.5% in Q2-24 and 5.2% in Q3-24; Q1-24 realised US$930/t equals US$1,035/t on a 6% basis per the company. Large provisional-price adjustments (Q4-23 -US$30M, Q1-24 -US$12M, Q2-24 -US$8.5M, Q3-24 -US$23.3M) make reported revenue diverge from shipment revenue. 2025: quarterly KPI tables retrieved for Q4-24 (reported Mar-25), Q1, Q2 and Q3-25; Q3-25 production volume not stated in retrieved text (only a -27% y/y remark in a secondary article, not used). Grade of shipped product fell to 5.0-5.2% Li2O in 2025; the company quotes prices on an SC6 (6% Li2O) CIF China basis and nets them down by grade. No offtake/prepayment deal was signed in 2025 per retrieved text; BNDES disbursement remained pending. Q2-25 release text says cash US$31.1M at 30 Jun but its KPI table shows US$15.1M (Q1 = US$31.1M); table value used. 2026: mine idle Oct-2025 to end-Jan-2026 (contractor switch then Labor Ministry waste-pile order); revenue bridged by sales of ~1% Li2O 'high-purity fines' (priced US$140/t per 1% Li2O at port, US$50/t EXW). Company now quotes prices as SC6 adjusted to its ~5% Li2O average (Q1-26 realised US$1,790/t on an SC5 basis). Q2-26 realised price per tonne not found in retrieved text. Heavy legal/regulatory flow Jan-Sep 2026 (Labor Ministry, local and federal courts, Feam/SUPRAM, TAC). Several company releases on PubT carry date-only T00:00:00 stamps; those were not used as first_seen when a timed copy of the same release existed.

companies.company: Lithium Argentina AG (formerly Lithium Americas (Argentina) Corp.; pre-Oct-2023 Lithium Americas Corp.)
companies.coverage_notes: Entity C0FA69 covers the pre-split Lithium Americas Corp. (LAC) in 2022-Sep 2023, Lithium Americas (Argentina) Corp. (LAAC) Oct 2023-Jan 2025 and Lithium Argentina AG (LAR) since. For 2022-Sep 2023 only Cauchari-Olaroz/Argentina events and the combined company's quarterly results were kept; EPS/cash figures in that period are combined-company (including Thacker Pass) and not Argentina-specific. US-only items (GM US$650M Thacker Pass investment, DOE loan, Green Technology Metals stake) were excluded. No production before first lithium in June 2023; first annual guidance (~5,000 t for 2023) seen in the Aug-2023 Q2 release (no separate earlier guidance release was found). Realised price: Q3-2023 and Q2-2024 disclosed only the pricing formula (China battery-grade reference less VAT and a KCl/impurity processing deduction of ~US$2,000/t, cut to US$1,500/t from Sep-2024); explicit realised US$/t starts Q3-2024 (~US$8,000/t) and is quarterly thereafter - useful for testing against MetalMiner China carbonate (270784). Production, revenue, cost and Exar debt figures are 100% Cauchari-Olaroz basis (LAR economic interest 44.8%). No numeric lithium recovery rates were disclosed in retrieved text (only qualitative statements, e.g. Q1-2025 shutdowns to raise recoveries), so the recoveries category is thin. Q4 production figures come from January preliminary-production releases rather than the March results. Timestamp handling: aggregator copies stamped exactly T00:00:00 (PubT, Financial Services Monitor) are date-only, so first_seen uses the earliest timed source on that date; note that timed PubT copies of the Q3-2024 (19:20 UTC) and FY-2024 (19:38 UTC) releases precede the ~22:05 UTC GlobeNewswire distribution by ~2.5 h (intraday US hours) - use the newswire timestamp if an after-close convention is preferred. Not yet reported by 2026-09-29: completion of the PPG joint venture (expected end-Sep 2026) and the Stage 2 updated development plan. Skipped as non-events: analyst price-target notes, ESG/sustainability reports, S&P/TSX index inclusion, fund holdings. No SEC 6-K FILING query was needed - newswire coverage of quarterly results was complete.

events.headline: Liontown orders SAG mill for Kathleen Valley, first long-lead item

events.headline: Liontown signs binding offtake term sheet with LG Energy Solution

events.headline: Lithium Americas closes Millennial Lithium acquisition, adding Pastos Grandes brine project

events.headline: Dec-2021 quarter output misses cut guidance; higher March-quarter price guide

events.headline: December-quarter report recaps DFS, native title deal and A$450m placement

events.headline: Liontown signs binding offtake term sheet with Tesla

events.headline: CEO Ken Brinsden to step down by end of 2022
events.summary: Alongside half-year results, the company said managing director Ken Brinsden will leave by end-2022 after about seven years; an executive search for a successor began.

events.headline: Core Lithium completes purchase of six mineral leases next to Finniss
events.summary: Core completed the acquisition of six prospective mineral leases adjoining its Finniss Lithium Project near Darwin, adding ground around the planned mine.

events.headline: Lithium Americas begins exploring separation of US and Argentine businesses
events.summary: Alongside a draft DOE loan application for Thacker Pass, the company said it is exploring spinning the US business into a standalone company; Cauchari-Olaroz construction was expected to finish in 2022. No final decision made.

events.headline: Binding term sheet with Tesla for up to 110kt spodumene concentrate
events.summary: Core signed a binding term sheet with Tesla to supply up to 110,000 dmt of spodumene concentrate from Finniss over four years at market-linked prices with a floor and ceiling, subject to a definitive agreement; shares jumped on the news.

events.headline: Sigma lifts initial concentrate output plan and eyes second-stage expansion
events.summary: Sigma now expects 240,000 t/yr of lithium concentrate from Q4 at Grota do Cirilo, 9% above the original plan; a feasibility study for a roughly $80 million second stage aims at 460,000 t capacity by end-2023.

events.headline: FY2021 results: Cauchari-Olaroz capex raised 16%, commissioning pushed to H2 2022
events.summary: Cauchari-Olaroz about 85% complete after Omicron disruption; commissioning targeted H2 2022. Capex estimate raised to $741M from $641M; $565M (76%) spent by end-2021. Stage 2 expansion of at least 20,000 tpa LCE advancing. FY2021 EPS -$0.32 vs -$0.51 consensus.

events.headline: FY2021 results: C$155.4M cash, Phase 1 fully equity-funded
events.summary: Sigma ended 2021 with C$155.4M cash; two equity financings raised gross C$178.7M, fully funding Phase 1 plant and mine. Plant foundation earthworks completed; civil works starting April 2022. Phase 2 could add 220,000 tpa (6% concentrate).

events.headline: March-quarter production of 81,431 dmt within guidance despite COVID labour hit
events.summary: Operational update: Pilgangoora produced 81,431 dmt of spodumene concentrate in the March quarter, inside the 75,000-90,000 dmt guidance, with COVID-19 community spread cutting staff and contractor availability. Shares fell about 5%.

events.headline: March-quarter report: LGES term-sheet deadline extended to end-April
events.summary: Quarterly report notes the LG Energy Solution term sheet termination date was pushed to 30 April 2022 to finish full-form negotiations, alongside the Tesla term sheet; offtake targets large foundation deals plus spot capacity.

events.headline: March-quarter shipments fall but average price rises to US$2,650/dmt
events.summary: Quarterly report: shipments 58,383 dmt (down ~26%) at an average US$2,650/dmt; cash A$284.9M. Management said unit costs exceeded guidance on lower output, fuel and higher royalties.

events.headline: Definitive full-form offtake agreement executed with LG Energy Solution
events.summary: Liontown executed the full-form LGES agreement for up to 150,000 dmt a year of SC6.0 concentrate, initial 5-year term from 2024, extendable by five years by mutual agreement.

events.headline: Q1 2022 loss widens on convertible-note revaluation; Cauchari commissioning still H2
events.summary: Q1 2022 net loss of US$0.35/share vs US$0.09 a year earlier and US$0.10 consensus, driven by a US$50.3M convertible-note derivative loss; expenses US$16.0M. Cauchari-Olaroz commissioning still targeted for the second half.

events.headline: BP33 underground environmental approval and crushing contract to CSI
events.summary: Development update: environmental approval granted for the BP33 underground mine, crushing contract awarded to CSI Mining Services, and DMS plant earthworks nearly complete with part of the site handed to Primero; first concentrate still targeted Q4 2022.

events.headline: Combined Phase 1+2 study values Grota do Cirilo at $5.1 billion
events.summary: Updated technical report: combined run-rate 531,000 tpa (72,200 tpa LCE), 13-year life, average cash cost US$454/t CIF China, NPV $5.1B. Remaining Phase 1 capex US$111M fully funded; Phase 2 capex estimated US$76M.

events.headline: Definitive offtake agreement executed with Tesla
events.summary: Full-form Tesla offtake signed, supply from 2024, conditional on commercial production by 1 December 2025; with LGES, up to 60% of planned output is contracted and a third deal would take it to about 85%.

events.headline: Finniss update: wet-season delays but first lithium export still targeted by year-end
events.summary: Business update said heavier rainfall and a long wet season had raised fuel use and delayed open-pit mining at Grants, but mining had accelerated; DMS construction handed to Primero; first shipment still expected by end-2022, subject to ramp-up and weather.

events.headline: Drilling lifts Grota do Cirilo mineral resource about 50% to 85.7 Mt
events.summary: Phase 3 drilling raised total estimated resources to 85.7 Mt from 58.9 Mt. Phase 1 commissioning still slated for December 2022, production early 2023 at about 37,000 t LCE/yr; Phase 2 would lift output to roughly 72,000 t LCE in 2024.

events.headline: Ford offtake and A$300m Ford debt facility; FID taken, capex lifted to A$545m
events.summary: Ford agreed a 5-year offtake (75kt, 125kt, then 150kt dmt a year) and a A$300m debt facility; board made FID on Kathleen Valley. Capex estimate rose to A$545m from A$473m plus A$93m working capital; ~90% of ~500ktpa start-up capacity contracted.

events.headline: June-quarter output estimate, record BMX pre-auction sale and Calix JV terms
events.summary: June-quarter production estimated at 123,000-127,000 dmt (up ~54%), toward the top of FY guidance; a BMX pre-auction bid of US$6,350/dmt (5,000 dmt, SC5.5 FOB Port Hedland) was accepted; key terms agreed for a midstream demonstration-plant JV with Calix.

events.headline: Final investment decision taken on P680 expansion
events.summary: Board approved the P680 project in the June 2022 quarter: primary rejection circuit (+100ktpa, A$103M) plus a 5Mtpa company-owned crusher and ore sorting (A$194M), lifting Pilgangoora capacity to 640-680ktpa from the Dec-2023 quarter; total ~A$297.5M.

events.headline: Finniss mineral resource up 28% and ore reserve up 43%
events.summary: Updated estimates lifted the Finniss Mineral Resource by 28% to 18.9Mt at 1.32% Li2O and the Ore Reserve by 43% to 10.6Mt at 1.3% Li2O; first lithium shipment still on track for end-2022.

events.headline: Lycopodium awarded EPCM contract for Kathleen Valley
events.summary: Lycopodium was appointed for engineering, procurement, construction management and commissioning at Kathleen Valley (reported value about $35m); production then expected from Q2 2024.

events.headline: Q2 2022: Cauchari 88% of budget spent; battery-grade purification circuit deferred to 2023
events.summary: Construction over 90% complete; part of the battery-quality purification circuit deferred to early 2023 to prioritise first production. $653M of $741M budget spent by June 30. $71.5M share of Cauchari FX loss; Q2 EPS -$0.12; cash $440.8M; Pastos Grandes ~$30M development plan approved.

events.headline: June-quarter report: FID, village contract, 75% of long-lead equipment awarded
events.summary: Quarterly report confirms FID after the Ford deal; accommodation village awarded to ADD Business Group, 75% by value of long-lead process equipment awarded, and major EPCM, power, freight and open-pit packages progressed.

events.headline: June-quarter production up 56%, price US$4,267/dmt; FY22 at top of guidance
events.summary: June-quarter production 127,236 dmt (+56% q/q) incl. first Ngungaju fines concentrate; shipments 132,424 dmt; average price US$4,267/dmt (SC6.02 CIF). FY22 output 377,902 dmt, upper end of 340-380kt guidance; FY22 shipments 361,035 dmt. May BMX sale US$5,955/dmt SC5.5 FOB.

events.headline: Former Rio Tinto executive Gareth Manderson appointed first CEO
events.summary: Core named Gareth Manderson, previously a general manager at Rio Tinto, as its first chief executive, following founding managing director Stephen Biggins' resignation announced in March; shares rose about 5-6%.

events.headline: Q2 2022: C$123.3M cash, commissioning still targeted for December
events.summary: Sigma reported C$123.3M cash at 30 June 2022, sufficient to bring the project into production; Phase 1 construction on track with commissioning expected to start December 2022. Management team strengthened with new executives.

events.headline: Maiden full-year profit of A$561.8M on A$1.2B revenue
events.summary: FY22 results: revenue A$1.2B, EBITDA A$814.5M, NPAT A$561.8M; year-end cash A$874.2M including A$282.4M letters of credit; average price about US$2,605/dmt for the year.

events.headline: Tesla offtake term sheet deadline extended to 26 October
events.summary: Core and Tesla agreed to push the deadline for a definitive offtake agreement from 27 August to 26 October 2022 to finish negotiations on the up-to-110,000t spodumene supply deal.

events.headline: Investor day: construction 47% complete, first production H1 2023
events.summary: Following Sigma's New York investor day, construction was reported at 47%, commissioning expected by December and initial production in H1 2023; Phase 2 would double output to 72,000 t LCE by 2024; Phase 3 PEA due H2.

events.headline: Preparations for first Finniss DSO shipment via digital tender
events.summary: Business update said preparations were under way for the first direct-shipping-ore cargo from Finniss before end-2022, to be sold by tender on a digital exchange platform because of strong interest.

events.headline: First DSO cargo sold by tender at US$951/dmt
events.summary: Core sold its first 15,000 dmt cargo of 1.4% Li2O spodumene DSO from Finniss by digital tender on a CIF basis for US$951/dmt, for shipment from Darwin in late Q4 2022.

events.headline: A$100 million institutional placement at A$1.03 per share
events.summary: Core raised A$100 million through an institutional placement of about 97.1 million shares at A$1.03 to fast-track exploration, capital development and growth at Finniss; the stock fell around 8%.

events.headline: Finniss mine officially opened; DMS O&M contract to Primero
events.summary: Finniss was officially opened as the Northern Territory's first producing lithium mine, with DSO exports targeted by year-end and about 80% of first four years' output sold to offtakers incl. Ganfeng and Yahua; Primero won the DMS operations contract.

events.headline: Two contractor fatalities reported at Cauchari-Olaroz camp
events.summary: Lithium Americas reported two contractor deaths in separate incidents at the Cauchari-Olaroz camp in Jujuy on 23 October 2022; not believed to be workplace accidents, investigation under way.

events.headline: September-quarter price US$4,266/dmt (SC5.3); cash jumps to A$1.375B
events.summary: Shipments 138,249 dmt at US$4,266/dmt SC5.3 CIF (US$4,813 on SC6 basis); a BMX auction reached US$7,708/dmt SC6-equivalent. Grade lowered to ~5.3% to lift yield. Unit cost eased to US$434/dmt (June qtr US$462). Cash A$1.375B.

events.headline: Tesla offtake term sheet lapses without a definitive agreement
events.summary: The 26 October deadline passed without a final supply agreement with Tesla; Core said Ganfeng and Yahua contracts still cover about 80% of Finniss concentrate sales in the first four years. Shares fell up to 10% intraday.

events.headline: Q3 2022: Cauchari capex estimate rises 15% to $852M; commissioning begins
events.summary: Key plant areas began commissioning late Q3. Capex at official FX revised to $852M (100% basis) from $741M, but no material change to Stage 1 funding at market FX; 85% spent. Ramp guidance due around end-2022. Q3 EPS -$0.30; $8.3M share of Cauchari loss.

events.headline: September quarter report: maiden concentrate now due first half of 2023
events.summary: Quarterly report said Finniss was advancing toward first DSO shipments in Q4 CY22 and maiden spodumene concentrate in H1 CY23, later than the earlier Q4 2022 concentrate target; resource and reserve increases also noted.

events.headline: September-quarter report: mining proposal approved, A$419.8m cash on hand
events.summary: WA government approved the mining proposal, allowing construction preparation; EPCM (Lycopodium) and wind-solar-battery power contracts awarded. Quarter-end cash A$419.84m; investing outflow A$26.05m, operating outflow A$2.53m.

events.headline: Lithium Americas decides to split into Argentina and North America companies
events.summary: Board-backed plan to separate into an Argentina-focused company holding the 44.8% Cauchari-Olaroz interest, 100% of Pastos Grandes and ~17% of Arena Minerals, and a North American company with Thacker Pass; targeted completion by end-2023.

events.headline: First DSO trucked from Finniss to Darwin Port
events.summary: Crushing began and the first loads of spodumene direct shipping ore were trucked from Finniss to Darwin Port, with ship loading planned from end-November for export before year-end.

events.headline: Government agencies approve A$250M 10-year debt facility for expansion
events.summary: Export Finance Australia approved A$125M and NAIF up to A$125M in a 10-year facility to fund Pilgangoora expansion (P680 primary rejection and 5Mtpa crushing/ore sorting), subject to documentation and conditions precedent.

events.headline: Maiden dividend flagged under new capital management framework
events.summary: Chair said the company plans to begin paying dividends from FY23 under a framework targeting 20-30% of free cash flow; P1000 FID still being progressed.

events.headline: Q3 2022 update: commissioning in December, cash falls, SBC restatement
events.summary: Cash C$85.2M at 30 Sept (C$58M by 18 Nov). Crushing commissioning by year-end, commercial production planned April 2023. Prior 2022 interim statements restated for understated stock-based compensation. Dana Perlman joins board; Brian Talbot COO.

events.headline: Sigma terminates Mitsui heads of agreement to keep sales flexibility
events.summary: Citing strong lithium prices, Sigma ended its March-2019 heads of agreement with Mitsui and repaid the C$4.0M drawn under it, preserving commercial optionality for its concentrate sales.

events.headline: AGM: DMS plant nearing completion, concentrate shipments early 2023
events.summary: At the AGM the chair said ore was being mined at Grants, DSO was being trucked to Darwin for shipping to China within weeks, the DMS plant was nearly complete and concentrate shipments were on track for early 2023; exploration budget to double. Shares fell.

events.headline: Expansion study targets 768,000 tpa, NPV tripled to US$15.3 billion
events.summary: Study (5.5% Li2O base case) lifts output from 270,000 tpa in 2023 to 768,000 tpa; capex US$155M. Cash cost US$401/t, AISC US$523/t CIF China; DMS recovery 65.0% Phase 1. Reserves up 63% to 54.8 Mt at 1.44% Li2O.

metrics.name: transport cost mine to CIF China (study)

events.headline: Sigma signs up to US$100M pre-export debt facility with Synergy Capital
events.summary: Senior secured pre-export facility of up to US$100M from shareholder Synergy Capital: 48-month maturity, 12-month BSBY plus 6.95%, US$60M initial draw expected in 2022; funds company to August 2023 including expansion engineering.

events.headline: Lithium Americas agrees all-stock acquisition of Arena Minerals to consolidate Pastos Grandes basin
events.summary: Deal valued at about US$227M: 0.0226 LAC share per Arena share (C$0.67, ~28% premium), combining Sal de la Puna with Pastos Grandes; Ganfeng to dispose of its ~16% Arena stake. Cauchari production expected H1 2023; cash US$392M at 30 Sept.

events.headline: Offtake price reviews lift pricing; P680 capex estimate rises 36% to A$404M
events.summary: Price reviews with major offtake customers lift pricing from December shipments; a BMX bid equated to US$8,299/dmt SC6 incl. freight. P680 capex revised to ~A$404M from A$297.5M; A$38.3M pre-FID funding approved for P1000, FID targeted March quarter 2023.

events.headline: Loading of first Finniss DSO cargo begins at Darwin Port
events.summary: Loading of Core's first 15,000 dmt cargo of 1.4% Li2O direct shipping ore started at Darwin Port on 30 December, bound for Fangcheng, China, at the tendered US$951/dmt.

events.headline: Maiden Finniss DSO shipment sails for China, first revenue event
events.summary: The vessel Rossana sailed from Darwin with 15,000 dmt of 1.4% Li2O spodumene DSO for a customer in China, Core's first revenue event, worth roughly US$14.25 million at US$951/dmt; focus shifted to finishing the DMS plant.

events.headline: December-quarter output up 10%; realised price jumps to US$5,668/dmt
events.summary: Production 162,151 dmt; shipments 148,627 dmt at US$5,668/dmt (~SC5.4 CIF; SC6-equivalent US$6,273) after offtake price reviews. FOB unit cost A$579/dmt, below guidance. Sales A$1.135B; cash A$2.226B. FY23 guidance (540-580kt, A$635-700/dmt) held pending half-year update.

metrics.name: unit_operating_cost_fob_usd
metrics.unit: US$/dmt FOB Port Hedland excl. royalties

events.headline: Kathleen Valley capex jumps to A$895m; plant lifted to 3Mtpa; DSO option
events.summary: Capex to first production revised to A$895m (incl. A$40m contingency) from A$545m, with initial plant capacity raised 20% to 3Mtpa and a direct-shipping-ore option; ~A$685m of funds left versus spend needs, more funding expected by end-2023. Shares fell ~8-10%.

events.headline: DMS commissioning starts early; Calvyn Gardner exits co-CEO role, new CFO
events.summary: Sigma began commissioning the DMS module a month ahead of schedule, first ore crushing mid-February, commercial production April 2023. Calvyn Gardner stepped down as co-CEO/co-chair (stays director); Ana Cabral-Gardner sole CEO; Gary Litwack co-chair; Rodrigo Menck CFO.

events.headline: December quarter: first DSO shipped, crusher commissioned, wet weather floods Grants pit
events.summary: Quarterly report: first 15,000 dmt DSO cargo sold at US$951/dmt, crushing and screening plant commissioned, cash about A$125 million, first concentrate still due this quarter; a very wet December left significant water in the Grants pit.

events.headline: December-quarter report: construction ramping, PPA signed, schedule held at mid-2024
events.summary: Quarterly report: on-site construction stepped up, most mechanical and electrical supply contracts awarded, power purchase agreement and open-pit preliminary works signed, village opened; Mt Mann pit cut to a boxcut ahead of underground portal; first production still mid-2024.

events.headline: First blast completed; open-pit mining starts at Kathleen Valley ahead of schedule
events.summary: Liontown completed its first blast and began open-pit mining with Iron Mine Contracting ahead of schedule, marking its shift from explorer to miner; DSO sample composites being prepared for potential buyers; first production still mid-2024.

events.headline: Crushing circuit commissioned; detailed engineering begins for 766,000 tpa expansion
events.summary: Sigma completed crushing-circuit and water-pumping commissioning on schedule, kept April 2023 commercial production and Q2 cash-flow targets, and started FEL-3 detailed engineering for the Phase 2/3 plant expansion from 270,000 tpa to 766,000 tpa.

events.headline: Report: Tesla weighing takeover bid as Sigma's top holder explores sale
events.summary: Bloomberg reported Tesla was talking to advisers about a possible bid for Sigma, while largest shareholder A10 Investimentos (46%) explored a sale to miners or carmakers; high price expectations could deter suitors. US shares jumped over 25% after hours.

events.headline: Half-year NPAT A$1.24B, maiden 11c dividend, FY23 guidance upgraded
events.summary: H1 FY23 revenue A$2,180.1M, EBITDA A$1,811.5M, NPAT A$1,241.9M; 309,255 dmt produced, 286,876 dmt shipped at ~US$4,993/dmt; FOB cost A$595/dmt. Interim dividend 11c. FY23 production guidance raised to 600-620kt; unit cost guidance cut to A$580-610/dmt.

metrics.name: unit_operating_cost_fob
metrics.unit: A$/dmt FOB Port Hedland excl. royalties

events.headline: A$250M government facility executed and US$113M bank refinancing signed
events.summary: Finance documents for the A$250M 10-year amortising EFA/NAIF facility were executed on 22 February 2023, alongside a new US$113M 5-year facility refinancing the existing USD syndicated debt on better terms; financial close expected in the March quarter.

events.headline: First spodumene concentrate produced from Finniss DMS plant
events.summary: Core produced its first batch of spodumene concentrate from the newly built dense media separation plant at Finniss; concentrate to be trucked to Darwin once target volumes are reached. Shares closed 4% lower.

events.headline: BP33 mineral resource more than doubles to 10.1Mt
events.summary: The BP33 deposit resource rose from 4.37Mt at 1.53% Li2O to 10.1Mt at 1.48% Li2O after drilling; Goldman noted more than half the addition was Inferred and deeper than 400m.

events.headline: 1H FY23 net loss widens to A$9.2 million before first revenue
events.summary: Half-year loss grew to A$9.2 million from A$3.3 million as first sales fell outside the period; cash A$125 million versus A$157 million, net assets A$327 million, EPS loss 0.52 cents. COO and CFO appointments noted.

events.headline: Grizzly Research short report questions takeover hopes and ramp-up claims
events.summary: Short seller Grizzly Research called buyout speculation misplaced, argued a US$2-3 billion price is more realistic, and alleged missing licences, weak leadership and overstated ramp-up speed. Shares fell about 5%.

events.headline: Yahua buys 18,500t of early concentrate, partly prepaid
events.summary: Sichuan Yahua agreed to buy the ~3,500t commissioning parcel FOB plus 15,000t under a prepayment (80% paid in April), market-linked with no floor or ceiling, on top of its 300,000t four-year offtake. Shares fell about 4-5%.

events.headline: Liontown rejects Albemarle A$2.50-a-share takeover proposal
events.summary: Board rejected an unsolicited, non-binding A$2.50/share scheme proposal from Albemarle (about A$5.2bn enterprise value) as undervaluing the company; Albemarle unit RT Lithium had built a ~2.2% stake on market. Earlier A$2.20 and A$2.35 approaches were also rebuffed.

events.headline: FID on A$560M P1000 expansion lifting Pilgangoora capacity to ~1Mtpa
events.summary: Board approved P1000: ~320ktpa added nameplate capacity for ~1Mtpa run rate once ramped up in the September 2025 quarter; capex A$560M; ~25-year mine life; first-five-year cash costs ~US$430-470/t. A partnering process for unallocated product was launched.

events.headline: FY2022 results: first Cauchari production due H1 2023, 40 ktpa by Q1 2024
events.summary: Construction substantially complete; first production due by end-H1 2023, ramp in H2 and full 40,000 tpa lithium carbonate rate by Q1 2024. Capex updated to $979M at official FX (from $852M), ~$645M at realised market FX; remaining company funding under $50M; Q1 2023 funding $38M.

events.headline: Maiden 3,500t concentrate parcel at port; Grants pit dewatered, mining resumes
events.summary: First 3,500t parcel of 5.6% Li2O concentrate reached Darwin a month early for Yahua; full mining resumed after the Grants pit was dewatered; both Yahua parcels priced off Fastmarkets spodumene 6% CIF China, 90%/80% paid in April.

events.headline: Sigma delays FY2022 annual filings; receives Nasdaq non-compliance notice
events.summary: Annual audited statements and Form 40-F due 31 March 2023 were delayed by extra audit work tied to the move to production and an SAP rollout; Nasdaq issued a Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) deficiency notice; insiders under trading blackout.

events.headline: Sigma obtains final environmental operating licence for Grota do Cirilo
events.summary: Minas Gerais regulator COPAM issued the operating licence (LO) after a unanimous 31 March vote, allowing sale of all current, future and stockpiled product; first production still slated for April 2023; expansion to be funded from future cash flow.

events.headline: Sigma achieves first production of 5.5% Li2O lithium concentrate
events.summary: Commissioning completed; initial runs reached 75% of nameplate throughput, full capacity expected July 2023, first ~15,000 t shipment targeted for May. Product spec: 5.5% Li2O, 0.5-9.5 mm particles, 0.65% iron oxide; ~300,000 t ultra-fine tailings to be sold.

events.headline: Finniss mineral resource up 62%; A$25 million drilling program launched
events.summary: Total Finniss resource rose 62% to 30.6Mt at 1.31% Li2O, with Measured and Indicated up 46% to 19.4Mt at 1.37% Li2O; Grants dipped 2% on depletion. A record A$25 million 2023 drilling program began.

events.headline: Lithium Americas completes Arena Minerals acquisition, adding 65% of Sal de la Puna
events.summary: Arrangement closed: Lithium Americas acquired all Arena shares, gaining Arena's 65% of the Sal de la Puna project (~13,200 ha in the Pastos Grandes basin). About 8.4 million LAC shares were issued as consideration.

metrics.name: Sal de la Puna interest acquired

events.headline: March quarter: first 3,500t parcel delivered, cash A$97.8 million
events.summary: March-quarter report: first 3,500t concentrate parcel delivered to Darwin, second parcel due by end-July, cash A$97.8 million before Yahua receipts; working on updated ore reserve. Shares rose.

events.headline: March-quarter price falls 15% to US$4,840/dmt; cost guidance raised
events.summary: Shipments 144,312 dmt at ~US$4,840/dmt (~SC5.3 CIF; SC6-equivalent ~US$5,522), incl. a 15,000 dmt spot sale priced off tolled hydroxide. FOB unit cost rose 9% to A$632/dmt; FY23 cost guidance lifted to A$600-640/dmt. Cash A$2.683B.

metrics.name: unit_operating_cost_fob
metrics.unit: A$/dmt FOB Port Hedland excl. royalties

events.headline: First trucks of concentrate and tailings reach Vitoria port
events.summary: Sigma trucked its first product to Vitoria Port ahead of planned May shipments of 15,000 t each of concentrate and tailings; 10 trucks in the first week, about 146 t of concentrate; still targeting 270,000 tpa by July 2023.

events.headline: March-quarter report: mining under way, cash A$305.1m, first Ford facility draw
events.summary: Quarterly report: first blast and 771,000 BCM moved, 444-room village, underground mining tender issued for H2 award, DSO ore stockpiled with samples sent to buyers; cash A$305.1m and first Ford facility drawdown after quarter end.

events.headline: First concentrate cargo loads at Darwin; BP33 mining authorisation granted
events.summary: About 5,500t of 5.6% Li2O concentrate was loaded onto the St Andrew for Yahua, and the NT government granted mining authorisation and approved the BP33 underground mine management plan, the final approval before an investment decision. Shares closed up 9%.

events.headline: Board approves arrangement agreement to split into Lithium Argentina and Lithium Americas (NewCo)
events.summary: Board unanimously approved the separation agreement. Lithium Argentina to hold 44.8% of Cauchari-Olaroz, 100% of Pastos Grandes and 65% of Sal de la Puna; John Kanellitsas interim CEO, Alex Shulga CFO. Shareholder vote set for about 31 July 2023.

events.headline: Q1 2023 (pre-split Lithium Americas): loss narrows to $0.04/share, cash $604M
events.summary: Combined company Q1 2023 net loss of US$6.4M (US$0.04/share) vs US$46.1M (US$0.35) a year earlier; no revenue. Cash and short-term deposits US$604M plus US$75M available credit. Cauchari-Olaroz ownership 44.8% LAC, 46.7% Ganfeng, 8.5% JEMSE.

events.headline: Board approves A$45-50 million BP33 early works; FID targeted Q1 2024
events.summary: Core approved A$45-50 million for early works at the BP33 underground mine while the feasibility study is finished, awarding civil works to Northern Australian Civil; early works and a final investment decision targeted by end of Q1 2024.

events.headline: Yahua tailings offtake and spot sale; 50% prepayment at 9% of LiOH
events.summary: Sigma signed with Yahua a three-year offtake for all ~1.3% Li2O tailings plus one 15,000 t spot sale of 5.5% concentrate; received 50% prepayment on the 30,000 t shipment, priced at 9% of the lithium hydroxide index (tailings with deductions).

metrics.name: first shipment total
metrics.unit: t (15,000 t 5.5% Li2O concentrate + 15,000 t ~1.3% Li2O tailings)

events.headline: Cauchari-Olaroz produces first lithium carbonate (below battery grade) during commissioning
events.summary: First lower-than-battery-quality lithium carbonate produced in commissioning; extra purification equipment for battery grade due H2 2023. Company warned output will run well below the 40,000 tpa design capacity and below battery spec during ramp-up.

events.headline: Late FY2022 filings completed; 2023 output guided at about 130,000 t
events.summary: Sigma filed delayed FY2022 audited statements: cash C$96.4M at year-end, C$67.1M on 9 June 2023. Guides about 130,000 t of 5.5% concentrate in 2023, 270,000 tpa run-rate in Q3 2023, expansion earthworks Q3 2023. Q1 2023 filings still pending.

events.headline: Separation circular filed; Pastos Grandes resource update technical report published
events.summary: Management circular filed for the 31 July 2023 meeting on the split; holders of ~23.8% (incl. GM and Ganfeng's GFL International) agreed to vote in favour; effective target by 15 Oct 2023. A Pastos Grandes NI 43-101 resource update was also filed.

events.headline: Second concentrate shipment of ~13,100t loading for Yahua
events.summary: Loading began of about 13,100t of spodumene concentrate for Zhangjiagang, completing the 18,500t additional sales to Sichuan Yahua; sold FOB and linked to the Fastmarkets spodumene 6% CIF China price.

events.headline: June quarter output 14,685t; FY24 guidance of 80-90kt disappoints, shares -14%
events.summary: Quarter: 14,685t concentrate, 5,423t shipped, C1 A$902/t (A$1,416/t with royalties), receipts A$114m, cash A$152.7m; FY23 output 18,274t at ~49% recovery. FY24 guidance 80-90kt at C1 A$1,165-1,250/t, FY25 lower; below expectations.

events.headline: June-quarter output record 162.8kt but realised price drops 33%
events.summary: June-quarter production 162.8kt (+10%); FY23 output 620.1kt, top of upgraded guidance. Sales 176.3kt at US$3,256/t (-33%); quarterly revenue ~A$800M. CIF unit cost A$976/t. FY23 sales 607.5kt at US$4,449/t average.

events.headline: Maiden 30,000 t shipment sails; concentrate priced about US$3,500/t FOB Vitoria
events.summary: First shipment: 15,000 t concentrate plus 15,000 t ~1.3% Li2O by-products, priced at 9% of LiOH: ~US$3,500/t concentrate, ~US$350/t by-product, FOB Vitoria. Plant at ~75% nameplate; max DMS recovery 60% vs 65% design. Technical-report site-gate cash cost ~US$289/t.

metrics.name: concentrate provisional price
metrics.unit: US$/t FOB Vitoria (9% of LiOH avg China/Japan/Korea)

events.headline: Shareholders vote former co-CEO Calvyn Gardner off Sigma's board
events.summary: At the AGM, Calvyn Gardner failed re-election as director with 68.8% of votes against; A10 Investimentos, holding 47.4 million shares, abstained on votes for Gardner and Ana Cabral.

events.headline: June-quarter report: first mill feed and DSO stockpiled, mid-2024 start reaffirmed
events.summary: Mining and construction activity rose sharply; first mill feed and direct-shipping ore were stockpiled, the 600-room village was commissioned and Iron Mine Contracting was engaged for three years of surface mining; first production still targeted mid-2024.

events.headline: Shareholders approve separation; CRA and IRS tax rulings received
events.summary: Lithium Americas shareholders approved the split into Lithium Argentina and Lithium Americas (NewCo); advance tax rulings from the CRA and IRS were received in July. Separation targeted for early October 2023, pending court and exchange approvals.

events.headline: FID taken on Calix midstream demonstration plant at Pilgangoora
events.summary: The Pilbara Minerals-Calix joint venture made a final investment decision to build the mid-stream demonstration plant at Pilgangoora, aimed at a higher-value lithium-enriched product with lower calcination emissions; earthworks followed.

events.headline: Liontown sanctions direct-shipping-ore project for early revenue
events.summary: DSO project sanctioned with contractor and equipment secured; 70,000t of DSO stockpiled by end-July, targeting initial sales of 250,000-300,000t of >1% grade DSO before concentrate production, first shipment by end-2023.

events.headline: Diggers & Dealers update: on budget, ECA support letters up to A$300m, Sumitomo study
events.summary: Kathleen Valley under 12 months from first production, tracking capex with ~60% of spend committed at end-FY23; export credit agencies of Australia, Korea and the US issued non-binding support for up to A$300m; downstream study agreed with Sumitomo.

events.headline: Pilgangoora measured and indicated resource rises 64% to 337.3Mt
events.summary: Resource upgrade: measured and indicated resource up 64% to 337.3Mt at 1.17% Li2O, with 82% of the total resource now in those categories; 109Mt added; extension targets to be drilled in FY24.

events.headline: Q2 2023: Cauchari 2023 output guided at ~5,000 t; 40 ktpa ramp by mid-2024
events.summary: Cauchari-Olaroz expected to produce about 5,000 t lithium carbonate in 2023, reaching 40,000 tpa battery-quality by mid-2024 (later than prior Q1 2024 target). $895M of $979M capex spent; remaining funding under $25M; first product at port. Pre-split Q2 profit US$25.8M (US$0.16/share).

events.headline: Ramp-up update: 95% nameplate throughput, record 846 t daily output
events.summary: Plant utilisation about 85%; August month-to-date throughput reached 95% of nameplate with several days at 65% design recovery; record 846 t/day. Reaffirms 130,000 t 2023 guidance and 270,000 tpa run-rate by end-Q3; Metso filter added as contingency.

events.headline: Delayed Q1 2023 results call reaffirms 130,000 t output guidance
events.summary: On its (late) Q1 2023 call, Sigma reaffirmed guidance for 130,000 t of concentrate by year-end 2023, said the dry-stacking module was commissioned, and noted FEL-3 engineering for the expansion was advancing.

events.headline: A$100 million placement at 40c plus A$20 million SPP; shares crash 25%
events.summary: Core completed a A$100 million placement at A$0.40, a 26.6% discount, and offered a A$20 million SPP for BP33 early works, recovery improvements and exploration; pro forma cash ~A$201-221 million. The stock fell about 25%.

events.headline: Tesla notifies Core of potential legal claim over lapsed offtake
events.summary: The equity-raise presentation disclosed that Tesla had notified Core of a potential legal claim over the failure to sign a definitive agreement under their March 2022 term sheet, and intends to pursue remedies if unresolved.

events.headline: Sigma sues former co-CEO Calvyn Gardner alleging trade-secret theft
events.summary: Sigma filed suit in Manhattan federal court accusing ex-co-CEO Calvyn Gardner and his daughter-in-law of taking trade secrets to undermine the company's sale effort.

events.headline: First Ganfeng offtake parcel and first lithium fines cargo at Darwin
events.summary: A 10,000t concentrate parcel, the first delivery under Core's long-term offtakes, reached Darwin Port for Ganfeng within specification, and a first lithium fines cargo was delivered to port as an outlet for low-recovery material.

events.headline: FY23 NPAT A$2.4B, 14c final dividend; FY24 guidance 660-690kt
events.summary: FY23 revenue A$4.1B, EBITDA A$3.3B, statutory NPAT A$2.4B (underlying A$2,276.3M); cash A$3.3B; final dividend 14c (FY 25c). Ore reserves +35% to 214Mt. FY24 guidance: 660-690kt at A$600-670/dmt; capex guidance above expectations.

events.headline: Q2 2023 results; US$10M Santander export credit line; second shipment at port
events.summary: Cash C$45.6M at 30 June; US$31.8M prepayment received; Phase 1 capex US$126.7M spent, US$8.1M left. Closed R$50M (US$10M) Santander green ACE line. Planned September shipments: 15,000 t and 18,000 t concentrate, 30,000 t by-products; expects Q3 operating profit.

events.headline: Albemarle lifts proposal to A$3.00 a share; board grants due diligence
events.summary: Albemarle's best-and-final non-binding A$3.00/share cash proposal (about A$6.6bn equity value) won exclusive due diligence; the board said it would recommend a binding offer at that price. Shares rose ~9-11%.

events.headline: First 10,000t shipment to Ganfeng and 15,000t fines cargo loaded
events.summary: The first 10,000t concentrate shipment under the Ganfeng offtake was loaded on the Clearwater Bay, priced on a formula linked to lithium spot, and a 15,000t parcel of 1.2% Li2O fines was loaded for China.

events.headline: Hancock Prospecting emerges as substantial holder with 7.72% stake
events.summary: Gina Rinehart's Hancock Prospecting was confirmed as the buyer of a sizeable Liontown stake, reaching 7.72% (about half a billion dollars), described as strategic with interest in downstream opportunities, complicating Albemarle's bid.

events.headline: Sigma launches formal strategic review after receiving multiple proposals
events.summary: Board evaluating proposals for Sigma Brazil, the Canadian parent and the project from energy, auto, battery and refining players; BofA and BTG Pactual advising; outcome needs majority-of-minority shareholder vote. 1% founders' royalty moved to a new institute. Shares rose ~17%.

events.headline: 22,500 t shipment to Glencore under new marketing collaboration
events.summary: Sigma trucked 22,500 t of concentrate (>5.5% Li2O) to Vitoria for Glencore, with 50% prepayment at a provisional 9% of LME lithium hydroxide price. Reaffirmed 130,000 t 2023 target; peak recovery 73%, steady-state target 65%.

metrics.name: provisional price basis
metrics.unit: % of LME lithium hydroxide price (avg China/Japan/Korea)

events.headline: Separation completion date set for 3 October 2023; one-for-one share distribution
events.summary: Lithium Americas said the split would complete on 3 October 2023; each LAC share entitles holders to one Lithium Argentina (LAAC) share and one new Lithium Americas share, with when-issued trading starting beforehand.

events.headline: Underground mining services contract with Byrnecut executed (~A$1bn, four years)
events.summary: Liontown executed the Kathleen Valley underground mining contract with Byrnecut, valued at about A$1bn over four years covering operating, sustaining and mine-related capital, following an August letter of award.

events.headline: Maiden full-year profit of A$10.8 million; FY24 guidance reaffirmed
events.summary: FY23 NPAT A$10.8 million with cash A$153 million and no debt; sold 14,774 dmt DSO and shipped 5,423 dmt concentrate. FY24 guidance reaffirmed at 80-90kt production, 90-100kt sales, C1 A$1,165-1,250/t. Shares jumped 22%.

events.headline: Capex raised 6% to A$951m; C1 cost guided at A$651/t SC6; 4Mtpa pulled forward
events.summary: Capex to first production now A$951m (up ~6% from A$895m, A$25m contingency), excluding A$26m early mine development and A$37m for 567kt pre-production ROM stockpiles; 10-year average C1 A$651/t SC6; 4Mtpa brought forward two years to 2027; DSO to be ore-sorted and stockpiled given weaker prices.

events.headline: Sigma rejects media reports, says expansion and strategic process on track
events.summary: Sigma called recent media reports inaccurate and affirmed that Phase 2 and 3 expansion plans (270,000 to 766,000 tpa) were proceeding as planned and that the strategic process continued.

events.headline: Hancock edges toward blocking stake, flags Kathleen Valley execution and cost risk
events.summary: Hancock kept buying toward a potential blocking position, said the A$951m estimate highlighted execution, ramp-up and market risk and that actual capex could exceed A$1bn; it overtook chair Tim Goyder (14.97%) as top holder.

events.headline: Record 890 t/day output; plant at 100% design throughput
events.summary: Peak daily production of 890 t (320,000 tpa annualised) of 5.5% Li2O concentrate; throughput rose from 75% in late July to 100% of design by 30 Sept; utilisation 88%; grade calibrated down from 5.9% Li2O. Shares fell 5.5% in a broad sell-off.

events.headline: Separation completed: Lithium Argentina (LAAC) becomes standalone Argentine lithium company
events.summary: Lithium Americas became Lithium Americas (Argentina) Corp., trading as LAAC on TSX/NYSE from 4 Oct 2023, retaining the 1.75% convertible notes due 2027. GM holds about 9.4% of each company. John Kanellitsas is executive chair and interim CEO.

events.headline: Hancock Prospecting lifts Liontown stake to 19.9%, threatening Albemarle scheme
events.summary: Hancock disclosed a 19.9% holding built on market at no more than A$3 a share, enough to potentially block the Albemarle scheme that needs 75% of votes cast; Hancock said it expects prominent influence as the largest holder.

events.headline: Albemarle due diligence period extended by one week
events.summary: Liontown extended Albemarle's exclusive due diligence by a week after it was reported substantially complete, following a four-week period granted in September.

events.headline: BP33 resource upgraded to 10.5Mt with 89% Measured and Indicated
events.summary: Infill drilling lifted BP33 to 10.5Mt at 1.53% Li2O from 10.1Mt at 1.48%, with Measured and Indicated rising to 9.36Mt (89%) from 6.94Mt; FID still targeted early 2024.

events.headline: Albemarle withdraws A$3.00-a-share takeover proposal
events.summary: Albemarle withdrew its A$3.00/share indicative proposal citing growing complexity of executing the deal after Hancock's 19.9% stake; Liontown said it will proceed independently with Kathleen Valley.

events.headline: A$760m bank/ECA debt package and A$376m placement at A$1.80; shares slump
events.summary: Credit-approved A$760m debt package (A$200m EFA ECA facility, A$450m commercial/CEFC, A$110m cost overrun) to refinance the A$300m Ford loan, plus A$376m placement at A$1.80 (35.4% discount) incl. A$10.8m to the chair and an SPP up to A$45m. Shares fell about a third.

events.headline: September-quarter price slides 31% to US$2,240/t; revenue down 42%
events.summary: Production 144kt; sales 146.4kt (-17%) at US$2,240/t SC5.3 (US$2,553 SC6); revenue A$493.1M. FOB unit cost up 19% to A$747/t; CIF A$1,004/t. Cash ~A$3.0B after A$421M dividend. P680 primary rejection plant delivered first ore in October.

events.headline: September quarter: output up 41% to 20,692t, realised US$2,560/t
events.summary: Concentrate output 20,692t at 5.0% Li2O, recovery 50%, C1 A$904/t, cash operating cost A$1,889/t; realised price US$2,560/t; A$27.7m repaid to Yahua on QP adjustment; cash A$202.1m. FY24 guidance on track, more tonnes at lower grade.

events.headline: September-quarter report: project over 50% complete, 90% of capex committed
events.summary: Kathleen Valley passed 50% complete with all major contracts let and ~90% of capital committed; 132,813t of ore mined; A$128.6m drawn from the Ford facility (A$52.7m undrawn); quarter-end cash A$285.0m; mid-2024 first production reaffirmed.

events.headline: Glencore prepays 50% on third 20,000 t shipment; trade lines available
events.summary: Sigma received Glencore's 50% prepayment for its third shipment (20,000 t), provisionally priced at 9% of LME lithium hydroxide; Santander and XP green trade-finance lines can be drawn on delivery to Vitoria warehouses.

events.headline: Q3 2023: 5,000 t guidance reaffirmed; first shipments; pricing at market less KCl processing fee
events.summary: First lithium carbonate shipped early Q4 2023; ramp-up sales priced at battery-grade market less a fee to remove excess KCl. 2023 guidance of 5,000 t reaffirmed; 40 ktpa by mid-2024; >95% of capex spent; remaining funding under $20M. Post-split cash $147.4M plus $75M undrawn facility.

events.headline: Q3 2023: first revenue US$96.9M, realised US$2,488/t, cost US$505/t
events.summary: First revenue quarter: produced 38,823 t (5.7% Li2O), sold 38,000 t concentrate plus 16,500 t by-products at US$2,488/t average; cash cost US$505/t mine gate, US$577/t FOB Vitoria; adj. EBITDA US$54.6M; net income US$36.4M; DMS recovery 49%.

events.headline: Fourth shipment: 22,000 t loading for Glencore at provisional premium price
events.summary: Sigma began loading a fourth shipment of 22,000 t for Glencore at Vitoria, with 50% prepayment at a provisional 9% of LME lithium hydroxide price, citing a cadence of about 22,000 t per month.

events.headline: AGM: construction over 60% complete; SPP raised A$13.8m; chair placement approved
events.summary: At the AGM Liontown said Kathleen Valley was over 60% built with nearly all capex committed and mid-2024 start intact; the chair's A$10.8m placement passed with over 99% support and the SPP at A$1.47 raised A$13.8m.

events.headline: Strategic review extends into 2024; Sigma Brazil to seek Nasdaq, Singapore listing
events.summary: Board said negotiations with finalists were advancing and contract drafting under way, but the review would continue into the new year; Sigma Brazil to pursue Nasdaq and Singapore listings solely to facilitate a strategic transaction.

events.headline: Phased power strategy targets lower power costs and emissions
events.summary: Pilbara released a staged gas-and-solar (later wind) power strategy for Pilgangoora expected to cut power unit costs and lower power emissions intensity ~48% by 2027, and up to 80% by 2030 if regional wind becomes available.

events.headline: Strategic review: BP33 early works suspended, mining curtailment considered
events.summary: After an ~80% fall in spodumene prices in 2023, Core launched a strategic review, suspended BP33 underground early works and said options included temporarily curtailing mining and cutting exploration. Shares fell 21%.

events.headline: Fifth 22,000 t shipment to Glencore; plant at 270,000 tpa design rate
events.summary: Sigma loaded a fifth 22,000 t shipment for Glencore (50% prepaid at provisional price) and said the plant sustained design capacity of 270,000 tpa in December, supporting ~22,000 t monthly shipments through 2024.

events.headline: Mining at Grants open pit suspended; stockpiles to be processed
events.summary: After an 85% fall in spodumene prices over 12 months, Core suspended mining at the Grants pit to preserve cash, continuing to process ore stockpiles; mining to resume when prices improve and an impairment flagged for half-year results. Shares fell 8-11%.

events.headline: 2023 Cauchari-Olaroz output ~6,000 t lithium carbonate, beating 5,000 t guidance
events.summary: Preliminary 2023 production of about 6,000 t lithium carbonate vs 5,000 t guidance; product at 99.5% Li2CO3 content, approaching battery quality. Carbonate plant running near 50% of capacity; KCl plant operational and ramping. Shares fell ~1.9% after hours.

events.headline: Ganfeng offtake expanded to up to 310ktpa for 2024-2026
events.summary: Pilbara amended its Ganfeng offtake, lifting allocation from 160ktpa to up to 310ktpa of spodumene concentrate across CY24-CY26 (260-310kt in CY25 and CY26), with some volume at Pilbara's election; all sold at prevailing market prices.

events.headline: Price slump triggers project review; A$760m debt commitment lapses; shares plunge
events.summary: After spodumene prices fell (almost 60% since October 2023), Liontown began reviewing deferral of the 4Mtpa underground expansion and cost cuts; lenders' A$760m commitment letter will terminate and a smaller facility is being negotiated. 3Mtpa plant and mid-2024 start unchanged. Shares fell up to ~26%.

events.headline: December-quarter price halves to US$1,113/dmt; FY24 capex guidance cut
events.summary: Production 176.0kt (+22%); sales 159.9kt at US$1,113/dmt SC5.2 (SC6 US$1,280); revenue A$264M (-46%). FOB unit cost fell 14% to A$639/t. Cash A$2,144M after A$758M tax. FY24 capex guidance lowered to A$820-875M from A$875-975M.

events.headline: December quarter: output 28,837t at 60% recovery, provisional price US$1,418/t
events.summary: Concentrate output rose 39% to 28,837t at 4.7% Li2O with 60% recovery; cash cost A$1,953/t; 30,718t shipped at provisional US$1,418/t plus 31,296t fines; cash A$124.8m; ROM stocks 289kt. Cost and capital guidance cut after mining halt.

events.headline: December-quarter report: underground mining begins, A$389.9m raised, cash ~A$517m
events.summary: Underground mining started on schedule with six portals and 352 development metres in under two months; A$389.9m raised in the quarter (placement, chair placement, SPP, options); cash about A$517m at 31 December; first production still mid-2024.

events.headline: Chengxin Lithium offtake extended and expanded through 2026
events.summary: Amended Chengxin Lithium offtake adds 60kt in 2024 (total 85kt) and sets 150kt a year in 2025 and 2026, about 385kt in total.

events.headline: BNDES letter of intent to fund second Greentech plant; full licence granted
events.summary: BNDES issued a letter of intent for development-bank debt to fund the second plant after Sigma filed FEL3 capex of R$492.4M (~US$100M). A combined LP/LI/LO licence (31 Jan) allows processing up to 3.7 Mtpa; plant 2 adds ~240,000 t (6% Li2O design basis).

events.headline: Half-year revenue falls to A$757M; interim dividend withheld
events.summary: H1 FY24 revenue A$757.2M on a 67% lower price (US$1,645/dmt SC5.3; SC6 US$1,880); NPAT A$220.2M; production 320.2kt, sales 306.3kt; FOB unit cost A$691/t; cash A$2,144.2M. No interim dividend, and capex being reduced to preserve capital.

events.headline: Ganfeng executive Sam Pigott named Lithium Argentina President and CEO
events.summary: Board appointed Sam Pigott, previously head of Ganfeng Lithium's international business development and chair of the Minera Exar shareholder committee, as President and CEO effective 18 March 2024; John Kanellitsas stays Executive Chairman.

events.headline: Ganfeng agrees to pay $70M for ~15% of Pastos Grandes project
events.summary: Ganfeng subsidiary to subscribe US$70M of new shares in Proyecto Pastos Grandes S.A. for about a 15% stake (possible adjustment up to a further 1.6%). Ganfeng to lead a regional development plan with its adjacent Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes project, due by end-2024.

events.headline: 1H FY24 net loss A$167.6 million after Finniss impairment
events.summary: Half-year net loss A$167.6m; 49,530t produced at A$1,926/t; 54.1kt sold at US$2,098/t SC6-equivalent, fines US$106/t; A$13.7m QP repayment booked; offtake shortfall risk flagged; Lucas mining and Primero plant contracts ended. FY24 guidance 90-95kt.

events.headline: CEO Gareth Manderson steps down; CFO Doug Warden interim CEO
events.summary: Alongside the half-year result Core said CEO Gareth Manderson would step down amid the strategic review, with CFO Doug Warden interim CEO and James Virgo interim CFO from 18 March; director Andrea Hall also resigned.

events.headline: Liontown signs smaller A$550m debt facility maturing October 2025
events.summary: A$550m facility (plus A$40m capitalised interest allowance) signed with CBA, NAB, Societe Generale, EFA and CEFC to refinance Ford and fund first production and 3Mtpa ramp-up; bullet maturity 31 October 2025; drawdown not expected before early Q3 CY2024.

events.headline: Half-year report: cash A$416.1m at end-February; debt drawdown conditions pending
events.summary: Interim financial report for the December 2023 half notes cash of A$416.1m at 29 February 2024, the January expansion review and the new A$550m facility, whose drawdown conditions were not yet met.

events.headline: FY2023 results: 2024 production target 20,000-25,000 t; Cauchari at ~50% of capacity
events.summary: 2024 Cauchari-Olaroz target of 20,000-25,000 t lithium carbonate; plant at ~50% of 40,000 tpa, briefly ~75% in March; nameplate on limited basis by mid-2024. Operating cash flow positive expected. 2023 net income US$1.29B (US$8.02/share); corporate discretionary spend cut 25%; no material Stage 2 capex committed.

events.headline: Binding term sheet with Ganfeng to study 32ktpa lithium chemicals plant
events.summary: Pilbara and Ganfeng agreed a joint feasibility study, due March quarter 2025, for a ~32ktpa lithium chemicals facility; if it proceeds the JV would be 50:50 with Pilbara supplying 300ktpa of spodumene concentrate. Location not yet chosen.

events.headline: Q4 2023: realised price falls to US$1,067/t; US$30M provisional-price hit
events.summary: Q4 shipments of 64,670 t generated US$67.5M, a realised US$1,067/t; reported revenue cut by ~US$30M of provisional adjustments. FY2023: >102,500 t sold, revenue US$135.1M, average US$1,321/t. Pro forma cash cost US$384/t, US$455/t FOB Vitoria.

events.headline: FID on US$100M Phase 2 plant to lift capacity to 520,000 t/y
events.summary: Board approved a second Greentech line adding 250,000 t/y (capex US$100M FEL3), commissioning targeted end-2024 and first production Q1 2025, funded by cash (US$109.4M at 30 March), trade lines and cash flow. Shares rose about 8%.

events.headline: FY2023 audited annual filings delayed for second straight year
events.summary: Sigma said its FY2023 audited statements, MD&A and AIF due 31 March 2024 would be late, citing extra audit procedures from hybrid non-operating/operating quarters after production began; insiders remain under trading blackout.

events.headline: CEO says Sigma will not sell at current lithium prices
events.summary: Ana Cabral-Gardner told Reuters Sigma would not sell at prevailing prices and is instead doubling capacity; Bank of America still leads the strategic review, which she said ran into heavy price headwinds.

events.headline: Finniss mineral resource up 58% to 48.2Mt
events.summary: Updated estimate lifted the Finniss Mineral Resource 58% to 48.2Mt at 1.26% Li2O (608kt contained Li2O), with Measured and Indicated at 27.9Mt at 1.32% Li2O, after 2023 drilling. Shares rose 5-6.5%.

events.headline: Eighth shipment sold at fixed US$1,160/t net of VAT
events.summary: Sigma began loading its eighth shipment, sold via a negotiated auction-style price discovery at a fixed US$1,333/t including 13% VAT, equal to US$1,160/t net of VAT.

events.headline: March-quarter price down 28% to US$804/dmt; record monthly output in March
events.summary: Production 179kt (+2%), sales 165.1kt; realised US$804/dmt SC5.3 (SC6 US$927), revenue A$192M. FOB unit cost US$444/t (+7%), CIF US$519/t. March output topped 80k dmt below $625/dmt; BMX pre-auction 5k dmt at US$1,106/dmt SC5.5. Cash A$1.8B.

events.headline: March quarter: stockpile output 24,927t but shipments slump to 10,199t
events.summary: Processing stockpiles produced 24,927t (down 14%) but only 10,199t was shipped; 19,756t concentrate and 20,000t fines held (about A$25m); cash fell to A$80.4m; ~139kt ore left to process until mid-2024; restart plans prepared. Shares hit multi-year low.

events.headline: March-quarter report: plant ~90% built, dry plant commissioning, cash A$358.1m
events.summary: Project over 85% complete with process plant ~90% on earned value; dry plant commissioning began in late March; ~1,535m of underground development in the quarter (~1,900m total); 1.1m BCM open-pit mining; cash A$358.1m. 4Mtpa deferral review due by mid-year.

events.headline: Proven and probable reserves up 40% to 77 Mt; 25-year life
events.summary: Reserves rose by 22.2 Mt to 77.0 Mt at 1.40% Li2O (from 54.8 Mt at 1.44%), within Phase 3 and 4 mines, extending operations to about 25 years at 520,000 tpa across two processing lines.

events.headline: Paste plant EPC contract awarded to GR Engineering
events.summary: GR Engineering won the EPC contract for Kathleen Valley's underground paste plant: two trains of up to 160 m3/h, designed to accommodate future 4Mtpa mining.

events.headline: Q1 2024: Cauchari output ~4,500 t, up 20% q/q; 2024 target reaffirmed
events.summary: Q1 2024 production about 4,500 t lithium carbonate (+20% vs Q4 2023); planned April shutdown for reliability work; 20,000-25,000 t 2024 target kept. Cash $86M plus $20M loan collateral to be released; Q1 EPS -$0.06 vs +$0.04 consensus. Local debt being refinanced with unsecured facilities.

events.headline: Q1 2024: realised US$930/t, plant-gate cost US$397/t, May price US$1,290/t
events.summary: Produced 54,168 t, sold 52,857 t; business revenue US$49.1M at US$930/t (US$1,035/t on 6% basis); reported revenue US$37.2M after -US$12M provisional adjustment. Cost US$397/t plant gate, US$462/t FOB. May shipment priced US$1,290/t (9% of LME LiOH).

metrics.name: revenue for business conducted in quarter

events.headline: Paul Brown appointed CEO from 4 June
events.summary: Core appointed Paul Brown as chief executive effective 4 June 2024, succeeding Gareth Manderson after an interim period under Doug Warden; shares fell about 6% on the day.

events.headline: P2000 pre-feasibility study outlines expansion to over 2Mtpa
events.summary: PFS: a third whole-of-ore flotation plant could lift Pilgangoora output to ~1.9Mtpa average over ten years (>2Mtpa first six) for ~A$1.2B capex; incremental NPV A$2.6B, IRR 55%; FOB costs A$550-650/t. Feasibility study due December quarter 2025.

events.headline: LG Energy Solution invests US$250m via convertible notes; offtake extended to 15 years
events.summary: LGES to buy US$250m (A$379m) of 5-year convertible notes at A$1.80, replacing the A$550m bank facility. Offtake extended 10 years (700kt over years 1-5, 1,500kt over years 6-15). Pro forma cash ~A$501m vs ~A$120m capex left; 4Mtpa FID by end-2025. Shares rose ~15%.

events.headline: FY24 output 95,020 dmt beats revised guidance; Finniss paused
events.summary: FY24 production of 95,020 dmt edged past revised guidance; concentrate sales 97,423 dmt with record quarterly shipments of 33,027 dmt plus 19,771 dmt fines; unaudited cash A$87.6m; Finniss to pause while restart is assessed.

events.headline: Short-term offtake for up to 100,000 dmt of ramp-up volumes signed with refiner
events.summary: Liontown signed a short-term deal with a lithium refiner (BSIT) for up to 100,000 dmt over 10 months from 30 September 2024, priced off battery-grade lithium carbonate, on top of the Tesla, LGES and Ford contracts.

events.headline: June quarter: stockpiles exhausted, processing ends; realised US$1,078/dmt
events.summary: Final stockpile processing yielded 20,563 dmt at 4.8% with record 63% recovery and A$644/t cash cost; 33,027 dmt sold at US$1,078/dmt, up 16.5%; site placed in restart-ready state with ~5,178t concentrate and ~75kt fines on hand.

events.headline: Record June-quarter output 226.2k dmt; unit cost falls to A$591/dmt
events.summary: Production 226.2k dmt (+26%), sales 235.8k dmt; realised US$840/dmt SC5.3 (SC6 US$960); revenue A$305M; FOB cost A$591/dmt. FY24 output 725.3kt beat guidance; FY24 price US$1,176/dmt. Price reviews with two major offtakers improved terms.

events.headline: June-quarter report: project over 95% complete, cash A$122.9m, hybrid power online
events.summary: Process plant ~99% built and project over 95% complete; 1,596m of underground development (~3,500m total) with North West Flats scaled back pending the 4Mtpa review; 216kt clean ore stockpiled; 95MW hybrid power station commissioned; cash A$122.9m before the LGES funding.

events.headline: US$22.4M Banco do Brasil export letter of credit to replace costlier lines
events.summary: Sigma signed an inaugural deferred US$22.4M export-financing letter of credit with Banco do Brasil and said it would phase out existing, higher-cost trade lines. Shares fell about 4.5%.

events.headline: First spodumene concentrate produced at Kathleen Valley on schedule
events.summary: First concentrate produced after wet-plant commissioning, starting ramp-up to 3Mtpa nameplate expected by end of Q1 CY2025, with recoveries optimised over 12-18 months; 216,000t of clean ore already mined from the open pits.

events.headline: First concentrate trucked to Geraldton; underground ore extraction begins
events.summary: Initial 145t of concentrate delivered to the Port of Geraldton ahead of a first shipment planned in the September quarter; underground ore extraction started in the first week of August.

events.headline: Q2 2024: output ~5,600 t (+24%), ~70% utilisation; pricing less ~$2,000/t processing deduction
events.summary: Q2 production ~5,600 t lithium carbonate, running ~70% of 40 ktpa; guidance unchanged. Sales mainly to Ganfeng at China battery-grade spot less VAT and ~$2,000/t impurity-processing deduction. Exar debt ~$315M (official FX); new $80M bank facility; cash $96M. Q2 EPS $0.01 vs $0.05 consensus.

metrics.name: Minera Exar USD and USD-linked debt

events.headline: All-share takeover of Latin Resources adds Salinas project in Brazil
events.summary: Binding scheme to acquire Latin Resources for about A$560M in shares: 0.07 new Pilbara shares per Latin share (~6.4% of enlarged Pilbara), adding ~20% to Mineral Resources and up to ~30% of pro-forma steady-state output; A$10M loan facility to Latin.

events.headline: Pastos Grandes stake sale to Ganfeng closes: $70M for 14.9%
events.summary: Ganfeng completed its US$70M subscription for 14.9% of Proyecto Pastos Grandes. Company expects Argentina's RIGI large-investment regime incentives to apply to Pastos Grandes regional development and Cauchari-Olaroz Stage 2; regional plan with Ganfeng's PPG due around end-2024.

events.headline: Q2 2024: CIF China cost US$515/t, realised US$894/t CIF, output dips
events.summary: Production fell to 49,389 t on a June crusher replacement; sales 52,572 t. Revenue US$45.9M, realised US$894/t CIF (US$1,056/t on shipped product). Costs US$364/t plant, US$424/t FOB, US$515/t CIF China. Q3 output guided ~60,000 t.

events.headline: FY24 profit falls ~89% to A$257M; FY25 guidance 800-840kt
events.summary: FY24 revenue A$1.3B (-69%) on a 74% lower realised price; EBITDA A$538M (43% margin); statutory NPAT A$257M (-89%); FOB unit cost A$654/dmt; cash A$1.6B. FY25 guidance: 800-840kt at A$650-700/t.

events.headline: BNDES commits BRL 487M 16-year loan to fully fund Plant 2
events.summary: Binding BNDES commitment for a BRL 487M development loan (16 years, 7.45% in BRL, 18-month grace, no asset collateral) covering ~99% of the BRL 492M Plant 2 budget; completion targeted summer 2025. Sigma to retire most unused short-term trade lines. Shares rose ~13%.

events.headline: Kathleen Valley passes 10,000t of concentrate at 5.2% Li2O
events.summary: More than 10,000t of spodumene concentrate produced at a weighted average 5.2% Li2O, meeting contract specifications; inaugural shipment on track for end-September.

events.headline: Ore reserve reset around BP33 and Grants for restart study
events.summary: Ore reserves updated to 9.25Mt at 1.38% Li2O, with BP33 up 223% to 8.68Mt and Grants 0.57Mt after depletion; Carlton and Hang Gong dropped; supports a ~9.5-year life at 1Mtpa, assuming US$1,450/t long-term spodumene.

events.headline: FY24 net loss A$207 million including A$119.6 million impairment
events.summary: Annual report: revenue net of QP A$189.5m from nine concentrate and four fines shipments; net loss A$207.0m, LBITDA A$47.8m, impairment A$119.6m and A$25.2m onerous mining-contract costs after the mining suspension.

events.headline: FY24 results: net loss A$64.9m with Albemarle and debt-cancellation costs
events.summary: Pre-revenue FY24 net loss after tax of A$64.9m including Albemarle bid costs and expensed borrowing costs from cancelled facilities; total assets rose to A$1,384.9m and borrowings rose A$202.5m as the Ford facility was fully drawn.

events.headline: Investor day: plan to reach 125,000 t LCE capacity via Phases 2 and 3
events.summary: Sigma outlined Phase 2 (250,000 t concentrate) and Phase 3 (+400,000 t) to reach 920,000 t (125,000 t LCE); debottlenecking incl. reprocessing ~200,000 t of 1.5% stockpile targets +10% output. Model shows adjusted cash EBITDA of $420M in 2025 on consensus prices.

events.headline: First shipment sails; maiden spot sale at US$802/dmt SC6, above spot
events.summary: Inaugural 11,855 wmt cargo at 5.2% Li2O left Geraldton on 27 September for an existing offtaker; over 28,000 wmt produced to date. First spot sale of 10,000t to a Singapore trader at a US$802/dmt SC6 reference versus ~US$750 spot.

events.headline: New A$1B revolving credit facility replaces government and bank debt
events.summary: Pilbara signed a A$1B RCF (two A$500M tranches, four- and five-year tenors) with a bank syndicate, repaying the A$250M EFA/NAIF facility and the US$113M syndicated loan to close it.

events.headline: September quarter: cash A$61.3m, restart study on track, Charger stake
events.summary: Quarterly update: cash A$61.3m (from A$87.6m) after one-off suspension costs; 5,178 wmt concentrate and 75,000 wmt fines unsold; restart study due 2H FY25; 7.6m Charger Metals shares and conditional 30% of its Bynoe project; new COO.

events.headline: September-quarter report: first sale 10,831 dmt at 5.33%; Ford supply deferred to mid-2025
events.summary: Maiden shipment of 10,831 dmt at 5.33% Li2O sold, paid after quarter end; over 28,000t produced in eight weeks; open-pit TMM 3,957kt. Ford supply to start on or after 1 July 2025 with pricing switched to a carbonate reference. Shares fell ~3-6%.

events.headline: September-quarter price falls 19% to US$682/dmt; revenue down 31%
events.summary: Production 220.1k dmt (-3%, P680 crusher tie-in), sales 214.5k dmt; realised US$682/dmt SC5.3; revenue A$210M. FOB unit cost A$606/dmt (+3%). Cash A$1.4B after growth capex. Latin Resources scheme agreement signed.

events.headline: Ngungaju plant to care and maintenance; FY25 output guidance cut ~100kt
events.summary: Under the P850 model the Ngungaju plant goes to care and maintenance from 1 Dec 2024 (restartable in ~4 months); FY25 production guidance cut to 700-740kt from 800-840kt, cost guidance to A$620-640/t; ~A$200M cash-flow benefit; mining fleets cut from seven to four.

events.headline: Calix mid-stream demonstration plant construction paused at 60% complete
events.summary: Pilbara and Calix paused the on-budget, 60%-complete mid-stream demonstration plant until market conditions improve or further government support is secured.

events.headline: Q3 2024: output ~6,800 t, commercial production declared; realised price ~$8,000/t
events.summary: Q3 production ~6,800 t (+21% q/q), at 75-80% of 40 ktpa; commercial production reached Oct 2024; 2024 guidance kept. Realised price ~$8,000/t in Q3, latest ~$7,000/t; impurity deduction cut from $2,000 to $1,500/t. Exar debt cut by >$110M to ~$202M; cash $92M.

metrics.name: Minera Exar USD and USD-linked debt

events.headline: Mine plan cut to 2.8Mtpa; H2 FY25 unit cost guided A$775-855/dmt SC6
events.summary: Revised plan targets 2.8Mtpa from end-FY27 (~530ktpa SC6 FY28-30), prioritising high-grade underground ore, deferring Northwest Flats to FY31 and cutting ~38,000m of development; up to A$100m savings; H2 FY25 FOB unit cost A$775-855/dmt SC6; recovery seen at ~70% by Q3 FY26.

events.headline: Q3 2024: output beats guidance but US$23.3M price settlements drive loss
events.summary: Produced 60,237 t; sold 57,483 t at 5.2% grade; CIF price US$820/t. Costs US$395/t plant, US$449/t FOB, US$513/t CIF China. Settlement adjustments cut revenue to US$20.9M; net loss US$25.1M. BNDES loan signed 10 Oct. Q4 guidance ≥60,000 t.

metrics.name: cash operating cost
metrics.unit: US$/t plant gate (incl. temporary US$25/t mobile crushers)

events.headline: AGM: restart study targeted for June 2025 quarter
events.summary: At the AGM Core said the Finniss restart study, re-optimising Grants and BP33 mine plans, flowsheet and capital cost and weighing strategic funding options, was on track for the June 2025 quarter; any restart depends on study results and markets.

events.headline: AGM: 674kt ore stockpiled, 5,300m underground development, three shipments made
events.summary: Chair told the AGM construction took 19 months from first concrete to first concentrate; 674,000t of ore stockpiled and 5,300m of underground development by end-September; three shipments exported at a premium to spot; revised 2.8Mtpa plan meets customer commitments.

events.headline: Lithium Argentina plans Swiss redomicile as Lithium Argentina AG, ticker LAR; Ganfeng standstill
events.summary: Company proposed continuing from British Columbia to Zug, Switzerland, renamed Lithium Argentina AG, keeping TSX/NYSE listings under new ticker LAR; operational HQ to Buenos Aires. Ganfeng signed a three-year standstill against seeking control. Shareholder vote set for 17 Jan 2025.

events.headline: Brazilian mining agency approval clears condition for Latin Resources deal
events.summary: Brazil's National Mining Agency approved Latin Resources' economic development plan for Salinas, satisfying a regulatory condition of the takeover; shareholder vote set for 16 January 2025, court approval still required.

events.headline: First cargo to LG Energy Solution in fourth and largest shipment
events.summary: Fourth and largest shipment, two cargoes totalling ~33,000 wmt at ~5.2% Li2O, sailed from Geraldton; ~11,000 wmt went to LG Energy Solution under the long-term offtake and the rest to a short-term customer.

events.headline: Q4 2024 production of about 75,000 t beats target; 2025 above 270,000 t
events.summary: Sigma said it produced 75,000 t of concentrate in Q4 2024, exceeding its target of at least 60,000 t, and positioned itself to surpass 270,000 t of production in 2025.

events.headline: 2024 output ~25,400 t beats guidance; 2025 guided to 30,000-35,000 t
events.summary: 2024 Cauchari-Olaroz production ~25,400 t lithium carbonate (guidance 20,000-25,000 t); Q4 ~8,500 t (+25% q/q) at 85% of capacity. 2025 guidance 30,000-35,000 t. Updated technical report: long-term opex ~$6,543/t, Stage 1 after-tax NPV8 $3.6B (100%).

events.headline: Shareholders approve corporate migration to Switzerland
events.summary: At a special meeting with 39.78% of shares represented, 99.23% of votes cast approved moving incorporation from Canada to Switzerland; effectiveness expected around 23 January 2025 subject to court order.

events.headline: December-quarter output triples to 88,683 dmt; revenue A$89.8m; shares jump ~12%
events.summary: Production rose 215% to 88,683 dmt (5.2% Li2O) and sales to 81,341 dmt over four shipments, revenue A$89.8m; unit cost A$1,000/t and AISC A$1,170/t SC6; operating cash flow A$16.7m; first LGES cargo shipped. H2 FY25 cost guidance of A$775-855/dmt kept.

events.headline: December quarter: cash A$49.7m, restart study due June quarter
events.summary: Quarterly update: cash fell to about A$50m (A$49.7m) from A$61m after a final QP payment, site upkeep and exploration; ~5,000 wmt concentrate and ~75,000 wmt fines held unsold; restart study on track for the June 2025 quarter.

events.headline: Redomicile to Zug completed; company renamed Lithium Argentina AG, ticker LAR
