events.summary: Corporate migration from Canada to Switzerland completed; company renamed Lithium Argentina AG with head office in Zug and operations HQ in Buenos Aires; TSX/NYSE trading under LAR expected from 27 January 2025.

events.headline: December-quarter output falls 14% under P850; price edges up to US$700/dmt
events.summary: Production 188.2k dmt (-14%) after Ngungaju went to care and maintenance; sales 204.1k dmt at US$700/dmt SC5.3 (+3%); revenue A$216M; FOB unit cost A$621/dmt. Cash A$1.2B. P1000 in wet commissioning; external brand to become PLS.

events.headline: Latin Resources acquisition completed; Salinas renamed Colina; PLS rebrand
events.summary: Pilbara completed the Latin Resources schemes, issuing 205,521,136 new shares (~6.4% of issued capital); the Brazilian Salinas project became the Colina Project, with a review, exploration and development studies to follow. Group now brands itself PLS.

events.headline: Pre-release flags half-year underlying loss and POSCO JV net loss
events.summary: PLS guided H1 FY25 underlying Pilgangoora EBITDA of A$71-75M and an underlying net loss of A$5-7M, and said the POSCO Pilbara Lithium Solution JV would post a net loss on low prices and ramp-up.

events.headline: Mid-stream demonstration plant construction resumes with A$15M WA grant
events.summary: PLS and Calix boards approved resuming the paused mid-stream demonstration plant at Pilgangoora after the Western Australian Government awarded a A$15M grant.

events.headline: Half-year statutory loss A$69M despite record output; P1000 first ore
events.summary: H1 FY25 revenue A$426M (-44%) at US$688/t SC5.3 (SC6 US$780); underlying EBITDA A$74M; statutory loss A$69M. Record production 408.3kt, sales 418.6kt; FOB cost A$614/t. Cash A$1.2B plus A$625M undrawn. P1000 first ore 31 January; no interim dividend.

events.headline: FY2024 preview: Q4 output 77,000 t; 2025-26 production outlook issued
events.summary: Ahead of a BMO conference, Sigma previewed Q4 2024 production of 77,000 t and 2024 underlying revenue of US$181M, and forecast production of 300,000 t in 2025 and 520,000 t in 2026 as Plant 2 construction advanced.

events.headline: H1 FY25 results: revenue A$100.4m at US$811/dmt; net loss A$15.2m
events.summary: First-half revenue A$100.4m from 100,240 wmt over four shipments at US$811/dmt CIF; EBITDA A$66m (A$27m adjusted for capitalised commissioning); net loss A$15.2m; cash A$192.9m; ~1.3Mt ore stockpiled; commercial production effective 1 January 2025; December recovery 59%.

events.headline: FY2024 results: realised ~$7,800/t, cash cost $7,130/t; Stage 2 and regional plans
events.summary: 2024 revenue $198M at ~$7,800/t realised; at a ~$10,400/t reference price realised is ~$8,300/t, with the 2025 pricing deduction cut. Cash opex $7,130/t (Q4 $6,630/t); 2025 sustaining capex $600-700/t. Stage 2 +40,000 tpa under RIGI; Exar debt ~$210M plus new $150M facility.

metrics.name: Minera Exar USD and USD-linked debt

events.headline: Core exits remaining Finniss operating contracts for A$19.5 million
events.summary: Core concluded its last operating contracts from the previous operating phase, paying A$19.5m over four months to take full ownership of site infrastructure, cutting care and maintenance costs; restart study still due in the June quarter. Shares rose 5%.

events.headline: Q4 2024: record 77,034 t output, CIF China cost US$427/t; 2025 guidance
events.summary: Q4 production 77,034 t, sales 73,900 t, revenue US$47.3M at ~US$900/t (6% CIF China); CIF China cost US$427/t, AISC US$592/t. FY24 underlying revenue US$180.6M. 2025 guidance: at least 270,000 t, CIF cost US$500/t, AISC US$660/t.

events.headline: Sigma hits Q1 2025 production target of about 68,300 t
events.summary: Sigma said Q1 2025 production reached about 68,300 t of concentrate, meeting target, with sales on plan and AISC in line with guidance.

events.headline: LOI with Ganfeng to jointly develop Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes basins, up to 150 ktpa LCE
events.summary: Letter of intent to consolidate Ganfeng's PPG project with Pastos Grandes (85% LAR) and Sal de la Puna (65% LAR) in a phased solar-evaporation plus DLE plan of up to 150,000 tpa LCE, possibly incl. lithium chloride; offtake and minority-partner financing explored. Shares +2.4% premarket.

events.headline: March-quarter output down 34% on P1000 tie-ins and cyclone; price US$747/t
events.summary: Production 125kt (-34%) on Ngungaju C&M, P1000 commissioning and Cyclone Zelia; sales 125.5kt at US$747/t SC5.3 (+7%); revenue A$150M (-30%); FOB cost A$685/t. P2000 study pushed to FY27; POSCO JV 30% option date extended.

events.headline: Record March-quarter output 95,709 dmt; unit cost falls 18% to A$816/t
events.summary: Commercial production declared; record 95,709 dmt produced and 93,940 dmt sold; revenue A$104m at US$815/dmt SC6e; unit cost A$816 (US$512)/t and AISC A$1,081/t; recovery 64%; operating cash flow A$14m; cash A$173m; first underground stope blasted in April; costs seen at top of guidance.

events.headline: WA government grants A$15m interest-free loan and fee relief
events.summary: Liontown signed a A$15m unsecured, interest-free loan under WA's lithium support program, interest-free until spodumene averages over $1,100/t for two quarters or 30 June 2026; also eligible for port charge waivers and tenement fee rebates for up to two years.

events.headline: Q1 2025 preview: CIF China cost US$458/t, EBITDA US$10M
events.summary: Preview: production 68,308 t (target 67,500 t), revenue US$47.7M (+28% y/y), sales cut off before a 29,000 t vessel loaded; costs US$458/t CIF China, AISC US$622/t; EBITDA US$10.0M, adjusted US$11.4M.

events.headline: Yahua legacy offtake terminated for US$2 million payment
events.summary: Core agreed to pay US$2 million (about A$3.1 million) from cash to end its 2019 offtake with Yahua, saying it widens options for strategic funding of a Finniss restart. Shares rose 3-4%.

events.headline: Restart study: 20-year underground plan, A$175-200m capex; Morgan Stanley on funding
events.summary: Restart study outlined a 20-year mainly underground plan, 1.2Mtpa plant, ~205kt SC6-equivalent a year, mining costs cut 40% to A$63-72/t, A$175-200m pre-production capex and A$1.2bn free cash flow at US$1,300/t SC6; spot then US$735/t. Shares +19-30%.

events.headline: Q1 2025: output 7,200 t (-15%) on planned shutdowns; cash cost $6,634/t, realised ~$8,085/t
events.summary: Q1 2025 production 7,200 t, down 15% q/q on shutdowns aimed at raising recoveries and cutting costs; April back above 85% capacity; 30,000-35,000 t guidance kept. Revenue $58M at ~$8,085/t; cash opex $6,634/t; further 5-10% cost cut targeted. Cash $74M; Exar net debt ~$218M.

events.headline: Q1 2025: first net income; production uncommitted; Plant 2 commissioning end-2025
events.summary: Full Q1 results: net income US$4.7M, cash US$31.1M, trade finance cut to US$51.1M, total debt US$165.3M. All production remains uncommitted; prepayment/offtake deals under evaluation. Plant 2 long-lead orders imminent, deliveries 3Q25, commissioning end-4Q25.

events.headline: CFO Luke Bortoli resigns; search for successor begins
events.summary: PLS said chief financial officer Luke Bortoli resigned to pursue other opportunities and will stay through a transition; a search covering internal and external candidates has started.

events.headline: Pilgangoora resource upgraded to 446Mt at higher 1.28% Li2O grade
events.summary: During the June 2025 quarter PLS reported an updated Pilgangoora Mineral Resource of 446Mt at 1.28% Li2O (5.7Mt contained Li2O), up in grade from 1.15%, with the Central area adding 87Mt at 1.5% Li2O.

events.headline: June quarter: price down 9% to US$740/t, AISC up 32% to A$1,227/t
events.summary: Output 85,892 dmt (5.2%) and sales 97,330 dmt, revenue A$96m at US$740/dmt SC6e; unit cost A$898/t and AISC A$1,227 (US$786)/t as stockpiles were drawn; record operating cash flow A$23m; cash A$156m; up to 150,000 wmt of Ford volumes resold to Chengxin.

events.headline: FY26 guidance: 365-450kt concentrate, AISC A$1,060-1,296/t, capex A$100-125m
events.summary: First FY26 guidance for the underground transition year: 365-450kt of concentrate at ~5.2% grade, AISC A$1,060-1,296/t and capex A$100-125m; 100% underground and 70% recovery targeted by Q3 FY26. Midpoints were below consensus on volume and above on cost.

events.headline: June quarter: restart study done, crushing plant bought, cash A$23.5m
events.summary: Quarterly report: restart study completed with first 10 years backed by 10.73Mt at 1.29% Li2O reserves; crushing plant acquired, completing ownership of site infrastructure; spending ex-Yahua payment down 67%; cash A$23.5m. Shares slipped ~3%.

events.headline: June-quarter output up 77% after P1000; FY26 guidance 820-870kt at lower cost
events.summary: Production 221.3kt (+77%), sales 216kt; realised price fell 20% to US$599/t; revenue A$193M; FOB cost A$619/t (-10%). FY25 output 754.6kt beat 700-740kt guidance at A$627/t. FY26 guidance 820-870kt at A$560-600/t.

events.headline: A$266m placement at A$0.73 plus A$50m from National Reconstruction Fund and SPP
events.summary: A$266m underwritten placement at A$0.73, a A$50m conditional placement to the National Reconstruction Fund Corporation and an SPP lift pro forma cash to ~A$422m; gross debt A$724m at 30 June (Ford A$336m incl. interest); first Ford repayment then due September 2025.

events.headline: Q2 2025: output 8,500 t (+18%); cash cost down 8% to $6,098/t; realised ~$7,400/t
events.summary: Q2 2025 production ~8,500 t (+18% q/q), H1 15,700 t; guidance kept. Revenue $64M at ~$7,400/t realised; cash opex $6,098/t. Exar closed $120M bank facilities at ~SOFR+2.5%; Exar net debt ~$233M; company cash $68M. Q2 EPS -$0.03. PPG feasibility study due by end-2025.

events.headline: Framework agreement for PPG joint venture with Ganfeng (67/33) plus $130M Ganfeng loan
events.summary: Three Salta projects to form a JV (Ganfeng 67%, LAR 33%) targeting 150,000 tpa LCE. Ganfeng lends LAR $130M, six years, SOFR+2.5%; up to 50% of LAR's initial PPG offtake (max 6,000 tpa LCE) goes to Ganfeng. Close due Q1 2026.

events.headline: Q2 2025: sales withheld, revenue falls 62%; CIF China cost US$442/t
events.summary: Produced 68,368 t but sold only 40,350 t (5.2% Li2O), withholding ~28,000 t amid price volatility; revenue US$21.1M, US$524/t. Costs US$348/t plant, US$442/t CIF China, AISC US$594/t. Net loss US$18.9M; cash US$15.1M; SC6 provisional US$637/t.

events.headline: FY25 statutory loss A$196M on 39% lower revenue; no final dividend
events.summary: FY25 revenue A$769M (-39%) at US$672/t SC5.3 (SC6 US$769); underlying EBITDA A$97M; underlying loss A$88M; statutory loss A$196M incl. POSCO JV losses and option write-down. Cash ~A$1.0B, liquidity A$1.6B; ~A$230M cash-flow savings; no final dividend.

events.headline: A$50 million placement plus SPP to push Finniss toward restart FID
events.summary: Core raised A$50m in a two-tranche placement at A$0.105 led by cornerstone Fourth Sail Capital, plus an up-to-A$10m SPP, to restart BP33 boxcut and decline work, order long-lead items and fund readiness; SMM cited A$0.12 and pro forma cash A$69.4m.

events.headline: Ganfeng offtake terminated; all Finniss output now unencumbered
events.summary: Core ended its Ganfeng offtake with a one-off US$2m (A$3m) payment; with Yahua already settled, no offtake obligations remain and 100% of future Finniss spodumene is free for partners or spot sales. Shares rose ~5%.

events.headline: FY25 results: revenue A$298m, net loss A$193m on A$81m stockpile write-down
events.summary: First production year: revenue A$298m at US$673/dmt average realised price; underlying EBITDA A$55m; statutory net loss A$193m after an A$81m NRV write-down of OSP stockpiles and A$159m D&A; breakeven operating cash flow; cash A$156m, borrowings A$831m; SPP raised A$56m.

events.headline: Tesla offtake repriced to spodumene index; Ford repayment pushed to 8 October
events.summary: Tesla agreed to move offtake pricing from lithium hydroxide indices to spodumene concentrate for all future deliveries, volumes unchanged to 2029 (supply began January 2025); Ford's first loan repayment moved from 30 September to 8 October 2025 during broader contract talks.

events.headline: Sigma replaces mining fleet; mining briefly demobilised during contractor switch
events.summary: Sigma said it was replacing its mining equipment supplier: demobilisation began the prior week and a new supplier was to remobilise that week, with downtime and lost production kept to a minimum; larger trucks aim to lift efficiency ahead of 2026 expansion.

events.headline: Ford loan repayments deferred a year; Ford offtake volume halved
events.summary: Ford deferred FY26 principal and interest by 12 months (first payment 30 September 2026); post-2026 offtake halved to 256,250 dmt from 512,500 dmt, with no Ford deliveries in 2027-2028 and a take-or-pay opt-out, freeing tonnes for spot sales. Shares hit 52-week high.

events.headline: Finniss ore reserve lifted 42% to 15.2Mt; SPP adds A$4.3m
events.summary: September-quarter update: Finniss ore reserve revised up 42% to 15.2Mt at 1.26% Li2O; A$50m placement plus A$4.3m SPP completed; cash A$35.9m; FID workstreams progressing and strong interest in the strategic funding process.

events.headline: September-quarter price up 24% to US$742/t; unit cost falls to A$540/t
events.summary: Production 224.8kt (+2%), sales 214kt; realised US$742/t SC5.3 (SC6 US$841); revenue A$251M (+30%). FOB unit cost down 13% to A$540/t (US$353). Ngungaju to stay in care and maintenance through FY26; P2000 study due FY27.

events.headline: BofA flags liquidity strain: prepayment deals unsigned, BNDES funds undrawn
events.summary: BofA downgraded Sigma, noting ~US$300M of customer prepayments remained unsigned and the BNDES loan undrawn, while Q2 cash of US$15M compared with US$44M payables and US$54M short-term borrowings; it sees Phase 2/3 slipping to 2028-29.

events.headline: September quarter: unit cost jumps to A$1,093/t; underground hits 1Mtpa rate
events.summary: Output 87,172 dmt at 5.0% and sales 77,474 dmt; revenue A$68m at US$700/dmt SC6 hit by port congestion and lagged pricing; unit cost A$1,093/t, AISC A$1,354/t; recovery 59%; underground reached 1Mtpa run-rate; cash A$420m; LGES conversion price reset to A$1.62. Shares fell 11%.

events.headline: PPG scoping study: 150 ktpa LCE, $1.1B Stage 1 capex, NPV8 $8.1B
events.summary: Scoping study for the consolidated PPG project: ~150,000 tpa LCE in three 50 ktpa stages, 15.1 Mt LCE M&I resource, cash cost $5,027/t (AISC $5,351/t), Stage 1 capex $1.1B, total $3.3B; after-tax NPV8 $8.1B, IRR 33% at $18,000/t. Salta issued Stage 1 environmental approval.

events.headline: Q3 2025: output ~8,300 t, cash cost $6,285/t, realised ~$7,522/t; spot-based realised now ~$9,200/t
events.summary: Q3 production ~8,300 t; 9M 24,000 t, on track to beat low end of 30,000-35,000 t guidance. Revenue $58M at ~$7,522/t; current realised ~$9,200/t after price recovery. Cash opex $6,285/t. Stage 2 expansion raised to 45,000 tpa LCE; RIGI applications in preparation. Cash $64M.

events.headline: Liontown partners with Metalshub for online spodumene auctions
events.summary: Liontown will sell spot spodumene through Metalshub digital auctions through 2026 and beyond, starting with a 10,000t auction on 19 November; shares touched a 52-week high.

events.headline: Optimised Grants plan cuts restart pre-production capital by A$35-45m
events.summary: Revised Grants open-pit design defers underground mining there, reduces pre-production capital by A$35-45m, lifts the Grants ore reserve 33% to 1.53Mt at 1.42% Li2O and would deliver first ore within a month of mobilisation.

events.headline: Q3 2025: revenue US$28.5M at US$626/t; mining taken in-house; 2026-27 guidance
events.summary: Sold 48,626 t at US$626/t realised (SC6 provisional US$847/t); revenue US$28.5M; 9M CIF China cost US$475/t; cash US$6.1M. Recoveries above 70% since January. Mining taken in-house, restart end-November. Guides 300,000 t (2026), 550,000 t (2027).

events.headline: First spodumene auction clears at US$1,254/dmt, well above spot
events.summary: Liontown's first Metalshub auction drew bidders from nine countries and secured US$1,254 per dmt, well above prevailing spot of about US$1,075/t; shares jumped.

events.headline: AGM puts special resolution to rename company PLS Group Limited
events.summary: At the 2025 AGM the board put a special resolution to change the name from Pilbara Minerals Limited to PLS Group Limited, reflecting assets beyond the Pilbara (Brazil, Korea); the ASX code PLS is retained. Board succession planning also flagged.

events.headline: AGM: over 360,000 dmt shipped; underground ramping to 1.5Mtpa by March
events.summary: At the AGM Liontown said it had shipped over 360,000 dmt, held A$420m cash, would be fully underground by year-end with underground ore at ~1.4% Li2O, ramping to 1.5Mtpa by the March quarter toward 2.8Mtpa.

events.headline: Binding offtake with Canmax for 150,000t a year in 2027-2028
events.summary: Liontown agreed a binding two-year supply deal with Canmax (Tianhua New Energy) for 150,000t of spodumene concentrate a year in 2027 and 2028, priced off a spodumene index formula.

events.headline: Uranium projects sold to Elevate Uranium for A$5 million
events.summary: Core sold its Napperby, Entia and Fitton uranium projects and other tenements to Elevate Uranium for A$5m (A$2.5m cash plus 8.9m Elevate shares) and a 1% royalty on Napperby, sharpening focus on the Finniss restart; shares hit a 52-week high.

events.headline: Open-pit mining ends; Kathleen Valley becomes fully underground
events.summary: The final truckload left the Kathleen's Corner pit after three years of open-pit mining, completing Liontown's transition to a fully underground lithium operation; shares rose over 4%.

events.headline: 2025 output ~34,100 t at top of guidance; record Q4 at 97% capacity
events.summary: Preliminary 2025 production ~34,100 t lithium carbonate (guidance 30,000-35,000 t); Q4 ~9,700 t at 97% of nameplate; Q4 cash cost expected under $6,000/t vs $6,285/t in Q3. Stage 2 (45,000 tpa) environmental and RIGI applications filed in December. Alec Meikle promoted to President.

events.headline: Labor Ministry shuts three waste piles at idle Grota do Cirilo mine
events.summary: Reuters: Brazil's Labor Ministry closed three waste piles citing grave and imminent risk (order 5 Dec, appeal rejected 13 Jan); the mine had been inactive since October despite a November target to restart within weeks. A BofA downgrade the prior week cut shares 15%.

events.headline: December quarter: reserves 15.6Mt, cash A$48.7m, FID work advancing
events.summary: Quarterly update: Finniss ore reserves raised to 15.6Mt at 1.27% Li2O on the updated mine plan; Grants to deliver first ore within a month of operations, cutting pre-production capital A$35-45m; funding talks advancing; cash A$48.7m.

events.headline: Sigma sells 100,000 t of lithium fines; says remobilisation on track
events.summary: Sigma sold a further 100,000 t of high-purity lithium fines from Vitoria storage at SMM-linked prices equal to a net US$140/t for 1% Li2O, said mine remobilisation would finish in January, and rejected reports of an operational injunction.

events.headline: LG Energy Solution converts US$250m notes into ~8% Liontown stake
events.summary: LGES elected to convert its full US$250m convertible note plus accrued interest into about 239.5m shares at the adjusted A$1.62 price (~8% of capital), removing the notes and their interest; remaining debt is the A$300m Ford facility and A$15m WA loan.

events.headline: December quarter: revenue up 91% to A$130m; unit cost down 17% to A$910/t
events.summary: Fully underground after open-pit completion; output 105,342 dmt at 5.1%, sales 112,122 dmt, revenue A$130m at US$900/dmt SC6 (lagged contract pricing); unit cost A$910/dmt, AISC A$1,059/dmt; operating cash flow about breakeven; cash A$390m; underground ore 308kt.

events.headline: December-quarter price up 50%, revenue A$373M; Ngungaju restart under review
events.summary: Production 208kt, sales 232kt (+8%); realised price up 50% q/q; revenue A$373M (+49%); FOB unit cost A$585/t (+8%); cash margin A$166M; cash A$954M. FY26 guidance (820-870kt; capex A$300-330M) reaffirmed; Ngungaju restart decision flagged for next quarter.

events.headline: Mining resumes at Grota do Cirilo Mine 1 with over 600 workers
events.summary: Sigma announced the resumption of mining at Mine 1 with more than 600 people on site; Brazil's mining regulator separately said the disputed waste piles posed no imminent risk.

events.headline: Two-year Canmax offtake with US$1,000/t SC6 floor and US$100M prepayment
events.summary: PLS agreed to supply Canmax Technologies 150ktpa of spodumene concentrate for two years from 2026 (extendable 12 months), priced at market with a US$1,000/t SC6 floor and no ceiling, conditional on a US$100M unsecured interest-free prepayment.

events.headline: US$96M production-backed revolver starts; 150,000 t fines sold at US$140/t
events.summary: Restarted production triggered prepayments under a US$96M revolver for 70,500 t of high-grade concentrate in 2026 (US$8M monthly, SOFR+1%, spot-index pricing; first draw 13 Jan). Sigma also sold 150,000 t of 1% Li2O fines at US$140/t, with a 350,000 t option.

events.headline: Half-year swing to A$33M profit on 47% revenue rise; no interim dividend
events.summary: H1 FY26 revenue A$624M (+47%) on ~40% higher realised prices; sales 446kt (+7%); FOB unit cost A$563/t; underlying EBITDA A$253M (41% margin); NPAT A$33M vs A$69M loss. Cash A$954M. No interim dividend; final dividend to be considered.

events.headline: Board approves Ngungaju plant restart from July 2026, ~200ktpa capacity
events.summary: PLS approved restarting the Ngungaju plant (care and maintenance since late 2024) from July 2026, returning ~200ktpa, with restart capital inside FY26 guidance; preparation costs may push FY26 unit costs to the upper half of A$560-600/t. P2000 study due December quarter 2026.

events.headline: Remaining 5,100 dmt concentrate stockpile sold to Glencore at ~US$2,023/t SC6
events.summary: Core agreed to sell its remaining ~5,100 dmt spodumene concentrate stockpile to Glencore at a fixed SC6-equivalent CIF price of about US$2,023/t, over 50% above its May 2025 study price, paid in the June quarter; ~75,000 dmt fines retained.

events.headline: LG Energy Solution sells entire 7.5% Liontown stake in A$419m block trade
events.summary: LGES offered all 239.5m Liontown shares via a Citigroup block at A$1.75-1.79 (floor underwritten), at least A$419m and a ~10-12% discount, exiting the register weeks after conversion; its offtake agreement stays in place. Shares fell ~8.6%.

events.headline: Blue Orca discloses short, alleging undisclosed litigation and mine safety risks
events.summary: Short seller Blue Orca said Brazilian court records show undisclosed prosecutor actions, creditor lawsuits and a technical report questioning mine safety and viability. Shares fell about 13% intraday.

events.headline: Updated Cauchari-Olaroz resource estimate: M&I up 42% to ~28 Mt LCE, supporting Stage 2
events.summary: Lithium Argentina published an updated mineral resource and reserve estimate for Cauchari-Olaroz; the measured and indicated resource rose 42% to 28.1 Mt LCE at an average 562 mg/L lithium, which the company says supports the Stage 2 plan.

events.headline: H1 FY26: revenue doubles to A$207.5m; A$184m statutory loss on LGES derivative
events.summary: Half-year output 192,514 dmt at 5.0% and sales 189,596 dmt; revenue A$207.5m at US$888/dmt SC6; unit cost A$985/dmt, AISC A$1,179/dmt; underlying EBITDA -A$7.7m; statutory loss A$184.0m incl. A$104.4m non-cash note derivative; cash A$390.5m; 4Mtpa expansion study refreshed.

events.headline: Finniss restart FID approved with ~A$300m funding package incl. Glencore
events.summary: Board approved restart FID: US$120m (A$170m) from Glencore, InfraVia (US$70m convertible notes) and Nebari (US$50m loan) plus a A$120m equity raise; Glencore marketing deal; NPV A$1.1bn at US$1,500/t; restart capital ~A$208m; first concentrate Sept quarter 2026.

events.headline: A$120 million two-tranche placement at A$0.21 completes restart funding
events.summary: Core completed a A$120m institutional placement at A$0.21 per share: an unconditional A$53m first tranche and a A$67m second tranche subject to shareholder approval, completing the fully funded Finniss restart package.

events.headline: High-grade sales resume; Q1 revenue seen near 28,000 t at US$1,712/t
events.summary: Sigma resumed high-grade concentrate sales in Q1 2026 and expects Q1 revenue equivalent to ~28,000 t at a grade-adjusted ~US$1,712/t. It sold 400,000 t of fines ex-works at US$50/t (~US$20M profit), leaving ~300,000 t in inventory.

events.headline: FY2025 results: 2026 guidance 35,000-40,000 t; Q4 realised ~$9,049/t; $85M cash distributed
events.summary: 2026 production guidance 35,000-40,000 t. Q4 2025 revenue $92M at ~$9,049/t realised; Q4 net income $31.2M; FY2025 net loss $76.8M ($0.47/share). Cauchari distributed $85M ($42M to LAR); $130M six-year facility closed. Q4 cash cost ~$5,600/t; sustaining capex $15-20M; EBITDA ~$460M at $20,000/t.

events.headline: FY2025 results: revenue US$110M, net loss US$50.2M; 240,000 t guidance
events.summary: FY2025 net sales US$110.0M, net loss US$50.2M; high-grade output 183,000 t vs 240,000 t in 2024 after the mining restructuring (mine idle Oct-Jan). Q4 operating cash flow US$31M; year-end cash US$6.2M. Guides 240,000 t over 12 months at US$592/t AISC.

events.headline: Second offtake: US$50M prepayment for 40,000 t/yr over three years
events.summary: Sigma disclosed a new US$50M prepaid offtake for 40,000 t a year of high-grade concentrate over three years from 2026, taking signed offtakes to US$146M with the US$96M/70,500 t deal. Total debt US$141M, including a US$100M loan to be repaid from offtake proceeds.

events.headline: NRW awarded ~A$50m Grants open-pit contract; mining to restart in May
events.summary: Core awarded NRW a ~A$50m surface mining contract at Grants, with mobilisation immediate and ore production from May; the pit holds ~784kt of ore for ~134kt of SC5 product. BP33 box cut works also began. Shares rose ~11-12%.

events.headline: First tranche of convertible note funding received
events.summary: Core received about A$26 million from tranche one of the convertible notes in its strategic funding package, to fund early works, site preparation, contractor mobilisation and initial restart capital at Finniss.

events.headline: Debut senior notes offering launched; Fitch assigns BB rating
events.summary: PLS launched up to US$500M of senior unsecured notes due 2031 to refinance existing facilities and for general purposes; Fitch assigned a first-time BB issuer rating (stable) and rated the notes BB.

events.headline: Upsized US$600M 6.875% 2031 notes priced; RCF cut to A$500M
events.summary: PLS priced US$600M of 6.875% senior notes due 2031 (upsized from US$500M), settling 22 April; proceeds repay the A$375M drawn on its RCF, which is reduced from A$1B to A$500M, with the balance for general corporate purposes.

events.headline: POSCO JV option to lift stake to 30% extended to July 2027
events.summary: PLS and POSCO amended their shareholders deed so PLS can exercise its at-cost option to raise its stake in the Gwangyang lithium hydroxide JV from 18% to 30% until 31 July 2027; the JV restarted using lower-cost spodumene inventory.

events.headline: Record March-quarter output 232kt; price up 61% to US$1,867/t
events.summary: Record production 232.4kt, sales 195.7kt; realised US$1,867/t SC5.2 (+61%); revenue A$567M (+52%). FOB unit cost down 11% to A$520/t; CIF A$733/t. Cash margin A$461M; cash ~A$1.45B. Ngungaju restart on track for July; FY26 guidance reaffirmed.

events.headline: PLS takes full ownership of mid-stream plant; commissioning starts with ARENA grant
events.summary: PLS acquired Calix's stake in the Pilgangoora mid-stream demonstration plant, secured up to A$38.1M of ARENA funding and a lithium phosphate offtake with Ningbo Ronbay, and began commissioning; first product expected in the September 2026 quarter.

events.headline: Early works and long-lead orders begin for Kathleen Valley expansion ahead of FID
events.summary: Liontown started early works for a staged Kathleen Valley expansion: a ~A$12m 5.5MW ball mill, Northwest Flats underground development and a permanent mine services area; A$15-18m spend in FY26 and up to A$77m before an FID targeted for end-Q1 FY27.

events.headline: March quarter: realised price up 87% to A$1,845/t; underground hits 1.5Mtpa early
events.summary: Realised price A$1,845/dmt SC6e (+87% QoQ) lifted revenue 51% to A$197m and net cash flow to +A$33m; cash A$424m. Unit cost A$981/dmt, AISC A$1,251/dmt; ~96kt concentrate; recovery 61%, with 70% shown on clean underground ore in April; 1.5Mtpa underground rate reached early.

events.headline: Second placement tranche of A$67m completed after shareholder approval
events.summary: Core issued about 320 million shares to raise ~A$67m in the second placement tranche, taking net new funding to ~A$157m; shareholders also approved the deferred ~A$44m second tranche of convertible notes, pending FIRB approval. Shares fell 3%.

events.headline: A$274 million BP33 underground mining contract awarded to Develop
events.summary: Core awarded Develop Global a three-year (plus two-year option) underground contract worth about A$274m for BP33 development and production, with mobilisation in June and mining from July; BP33 first ore targeted mid-2027. Shares fell about 8%.

events.headline: Q1 2026: ~9,700 t at ~97% capacity; realised ~$16,818/t; cash cost $5,391/t
events.summary: Q1 2026 production ~9,700 t at ~97% of nameplate; revenue $168.3M at ~$16,818/t realised with minimal quality discount; cash opex $5,391/t vs long-term target ~$5,400/t. About $100M distributed by the operation since January. 35,000-40,000 t guidance reiterated; ASX secondary listing under consideration.

events.headline: Cauchari-Olaroz Stage 2 expansion approved under Argentina's RIGI regime
events.summary: Stage 2 (45,000 tpa LCE) received RIGI approval, giving long-term fiscal stability, duty-free capital imports, export-duty exemption after three years and freer FX access for debt service and distributions. Definitive Stage 2 plan due mid-2026; PPG RIGI application submitted early 2026.

events.headline: Q1 2026: revenue US$42M, realised US$1,790/t (SC5); AISC guide US$710/t
events.summary: Sold 23,000 t concentrate-equivalent for US$42M at US$1,790/t (SC5 basis); 61% gross, 26% net margin. Cash US$28M (15 May). New cost guidance: CIF China US$624/t, AISC US$710/t for 240,000 t. BNDES guarantee obtained; loan undrawn.

events.headline: Local judge orders damages collateral over mine impacts; Sigma appeals
events.summary: A local court in Aracuai ruled on 17 May, with potential collateral of US$10M (reported as a R$50M deposit) over dust, tremors and noise claims; Sigma said nothing is payable before final judgment and is appealing. Shares fell 12.25% on 18 May.

events.headline: Mining restarts at Grants open pit
events.summary: Blasting and excavation resumed at the Grants open pit under the NRW contract, marking the physical restart of Finniss; ore processing expected in the September quarter and first concentrate shipment in the December quarter.

events.headline: State appeals court overturns local ruling and US$10M collateral risk
events.summary: A Minas Gerais Court of Justice judge overturned the lower-court decision that carried potential US$10M collateral, instead requiring Sigma to fund an independent study of operational impacts on Aracuai and Itinga residents.

events.headline: Second lithium fines sale to Glencore: 25,000t at ~US$270/t CIF
events.summary: Core agreed to sell another 25,000t of DSO lithium fines to Glencore at ~US$270/t CIF for June shipment, after an April 20,000t fines sale at ~US$290/t; 2026 stockpile sales total ~A$28.5m. Shares closed 5.9% lower.

events.headline: Chair Greg English to retire; exploration assets to be spun out as Axiant
events.summary: Core plans to spin out Northern Territory and South Australian exploration assets into a new gold explorer, Axiant Resources, via IPO; chair Greg English retires on 30 June to chair Axiant, with director Malcolm McComas becoming chair.

events.headline: BP33 decline development starts; first stockpile shipment leaves Darwin
events.summary: The BP33 portal cut was completed and underground decline development began; Core's first shipment since restart, 20,000t of lithium fines and 5,000t of spodumene concentrate, departed Darwin. BP33 first ore targeted mid-2027, nameplate mid-2028.

events.headline: Q2 2026 output of 35,000 t beats guidance; 70% plant recovery
events.summary: Sigma produced 35,000 t of concentrate in Q2 2026, above guidance, after its mining fleet reached full run-rate; plant recovery 70% with ~20% yield. Guidance: 240,000 t over 12 months at CIF China US$624/t; prices quoted as SC6 adjusted to its ~5% Li2O average.

events.headline: June quarter: restart in execution, cash A$182m, ~A$320m liquidity
events.summary: June-quarter call: funding secured, all major contracts awarded, Grants mining and BP33 development under way; cash A$182m and about A$320m of available funding; plant recommissioning in September quarter and first new-concentrate shipment in the December quarter.

events.headline: Environmental notice partially halts operations; Feam bans mining pending TAC
events.summary: Sigma disclosed a SUPRAM environmental notice and began TAC talks with Minas Gerais, agreeing fines up to US$540,000. Argus reported Feam barred mining at Grota do Cirilo on 23 July citing illegal clearing and unauthorised groundwater use.

events.headline: June quarter: US$1,880/dmt realised, revenue A$235m, cash builds to A$561m
events.summary: Output 103,111 dmt and sales 108,489 dmt at 5.0%; realised US$1,880/dmt SC6e; revenue A$235m; operating cash flow A$180m, net cash flow A$137m, cash A$561m; unit cost A$995/dmt (diesel costs up), AISC A$1,314/dmt; recovery 63%; record 3,316m underground development. Shares fell 6.7%.

events.headline: FY27 guidance: 390-440kdmt SC6, unit cost A$1,050-1,250/t, capex A$320-370m
events.summary: Liontown guided FY27 output of 390-440k dmt SC6, unit operating cost A$1,050-1,250/dmt (up from A$987/t in FY26 on more mining and Northwest Flats) and capex A$320-370m excluding expansion capital; expansion FID expected in September 2026.

events.headline: June-quarter price US$2,107/t; FY26 output record 879.5kt; FY27 guided 1.03-1.1Mt
events.summary: Production 214.3kt, record sales 249.9kt at US$2,107/t SC5.2 (+13%); revenue A$743M; FOB cost A$616/t on Ngungaju restart costs. FY26 output 879.5kt beat guidance. Ngungaju restarted 1 July. FY27 guidance 1.03-1.10Mt; capex A$620-685M. Cash A$2.29B.

events.headline: Second convertible note tranche of ~A$44m received after FIRB approval
events.summary: Core received about A$44m from the second tranche of the A$70m convertible note facility from InfraVia and Glencore after Foreign Investment Review Board approval. Shares rose 4%.

events.headline: Cauchari-Olaroz closes $220M of new unsecured debt facilities
events.summary: Minera Exar closed a $50M two-year facility (June 2026) replacing short-term lines and a $170M three-year syndicated facility (August 2026) at under 5% interest. Facilities are unsecured, Ganfeng-guaranteed with a 49% Lithium Argentina counter-guarantee, drawable until Q2 2027.

events.headline: Q2 2026: 9,280 t; realised ~$19,563/t, 70% cash margin; Exar net debt cut $114M
events.summary: Q2 output 9,280 t after a May shutdown; H1 averaged 95% of design; 35,000-40,000 t guidance kept. Revenue $174M at ~$19,563/t; cash opex $5,897/t; adjusted EBITDA $110M; FCF $141M; net income $27M. Exar net debt down $114M. Initial 10,000 tpa modular DLE phase planned.

events.headline: PLS buys Lithium Ionic's Salinas properties next to Colina for US$37.5M
events.summary: A PLS subsidiary agreed to buy Lithium Ionic's Salinas properties, incl. the Baixa Grande resource adjacent to Colina, for US$37.5M cash (US$30M at closing, US$7.5M on Colina FID or by end-2029); the seller keeps a 2.0% FOB royalty.

events.headline: Q2 2026: record US$54.7M revenue, CIF China cost US$452/t; Plant 2 delayed
events.summary: Q2 production 35,400 t, sales 24,400 t, revenue US$54.7M; costs US$401/t plant gate, US$452/t CIF China, AISC US$668/t. H1 net profit US$8.49M. Guidance 240,000 t (12 months), 330,000 t FY27; Plant 2 now end-2027, Plant 3 end-2028.

events.headline: TAC signed with Minas Gerais; mining and plant fully back online
events.summary: After signing a TAC with Minas Gerais, Sigma said operations were fully restored; TAC capex ~US$1M plus fines up to US$540,000. Targets 240,000 t within 12 months and 330,000 t in FY27; greenlit SANY fleet upgrade; nameplate stated at 330,000 t/yr.

events.headline: FY26 NPAT A$526M on 152% revenue rise; 5c final dividend reinstated
events.summary: FY26 revenue A$1.934B (+152%) at US$1,488/t (+121%); underlying EBITDA A$1.137B (59% margin); NPAT A$526M (EPS A$0.1614); FOB unit cost A$569/t; cash ~A$2.3B. Final dividend 5c fully franked (~A$161M). FY27 FOB cost guidance A$575-625/t.

events.headline: PPG joint venture definitive agreements signed; Ganfeng to buy $180M convertible note
events.summary: Definitive PPG JV agreements signed (Ganfeng 67%, LAR 33%, Ganfeng operates, pro-rata funding and offtake). Ganfeng to buy a $180M six-year 4% unsecured convertible note, convertible at $12.50 (~96% premium); proceeds plus cash repay $259M notes due Jan-2027; $130M facility terminated.

metrics.name: Ganfeng fully diluted stake after conversion

events.headline: FY26 results: maiden profit A$93m on record A$639m revenue
events.summary: Record revenue A$639m on 35% more tonnes and a 75% higher realised price (A$1,379/t); NPAT A$93m including A$113m deferred tax asset recognition, underlying NPAT A$14m; underlying EBITDA A$147m; operating cash flow A$182m; unit cost A$984/t; cash A$561m; expansion FID due in September.

events.headline: Final ~25,000t lithium fines stockpile sold to Glencore
events.summary: Core agreed to sell its final ~25,000t batch of lithium fines stockpile to Glencore at a base price of about $285/t CIF, subject to adjustments, for shipment in the current quarter.

metrics.name: realised_price
metrics.unit: $/t CIF base (currency not stated in source)

events.headline: Sigma lists CDIs on the ASX under ticker SAU
events.summary: Sigma was admitted to the ASX as a foreign exempt issuer; CDIs (1:1 with common shares) began quotation under SAU, while Nasdaq and TSXV listings continue. No capital raising was disclosed.

events.headline: Federal judge suspends Grota do Cirilo environmental licences and mining
events.summary: Reuters: on 4 September a Brazilian judge suspended environmental licences and mining at Grota do Cirilo in a suit by a Quilombola federation, barred new state permits and set fines for continued operation; an independent georeferenced survey was ordered.

events.headline: First spodumene concentrate produced from recommissioned Finniss plant
events.summary: The recommissioned Finniss plant produced its first spodumene concentrate within six months of FID, after Grants mining resumed in May and crushing in August; upgrades lift capacity ~20% to 1.2Mtpa; first shipment targeted for the December quarter.

events.headline: Sigma says operations continue despite ruling; shares fall 11.5% premarket
events.summary: Sigma said it had not been notified of the ruling, called it issued without due process, said operations continue and reaffirmed 240,000 t within 12 months and 330,000 t in FY27; it disputed that the ruling overrides the TAC. Shares fell 11.5% premarket.

events.headline: Ganfeng's $180M convertible note investment closes; PPG JV completion due end-September
events.summary: Lithium Argentina closed the $180M six-year 4% convertible note to Ganfeng (conversion $12.50/share); proceeds and cash to fully repay the $259M notes due January 2027. PPG joint venture completion still expected by end of September 2026.

events.headline: Feam suspends five Sigma operating licences under federal injunction
events.summary: Minas Gerais regulator Feam suspended five of Sigma's environmental operating licences on 24 September to comply with the 4 September federal injunction; federal deputies had filed a criminal complaint alleging operations continued in defiance of the order.

events.headline: Sigma says operations normal, disputes validity of Feam suspension
events.summary: Sigma said mining and plant operations continue normally, mining concessions are unaffected, and Feam's act has no legal validity while its federal appeal is pending; it called reports of suspended licences incorrect. States nameplate 330,000 t, Phase 2 to 580,000 t.
